decisions.choice: "መፍታት" (divorce) for the husband; "መለየት", "መተው" (separate, leave) for the wife
decisions.reason: "ፈታ" is the ordinary Amharic verb for a man divorcing his wife, which is what the Greek's "leave" means here (m2); for the wife the Greek says "separate", and Amharic keeps the difference.

decisions.choice: "तलाक़ न दे" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Both Greek verbs mean ending the marriage (meaning decision m2); Balanced and Readable say "तलाक़", the word Mark settled, for the husband's act, and Literal keeps "छोड़े". The same in verses 12-13.

decisions.choice: "मेल हो जाए"
decisions.reason: Reconcile keeps the key term "मेल" at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the everyday "सुलह".

decisions.choice: примирится
decisions.reason: The key term for reconciling, "примирить", as in Romans 5.

decisions.choice: уходить ... разводиться
decisions.reason: Both verbs mean ending the marriage (m2); Balanced and Readable use the words a reader would use for it, as the English does. Literal keeps "оставлять".

decisions.choice: Literal sets the aside off with "――" where the English uses parentheses
decisions.reason: The style guide gives the dash for Japanese; the aside interrupts the Lord's command (m3).

decisions.choice: "別れる" for the wife, "去らせる" (L), "離縁する" (B), "離婚する" (R) for the husband
decisions.reason: As Matthew 5:31-32 (離縁 at L and B, 離婚 at R); the English also uses "leave" and "divorce".

source.text: Τοῖς δὲ λοιποῖς λέγω ἐγώ, οὐχ ὁ κύριος· εἴ τις ἀδελφὸς γυναῖκα ἔχει ἄπιστον, καὶ αὕτη συνευδοκεῖ οἰκεῖν μετ’ αὐτοῦ, μὴ ἀφιέτω αὐτήν·

records.literal_gloss: To the but rest say I, not the Lord: if any brother a wife has unbelieving, and she consents to live with him, let him not leave her;

en.L: But to the rest I say, I, not the Lord: if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she consents to live with him, let him not leave her.
en.B: To everyone else I say this myself; it is not a word from the Lord. Suppose a brother has a wife who does not believe, and she is content to go on living with him: he must not divorce her.
en.R: To the rest of you I say this. It is my own word, not a command from the Lord. If a man who is a believer has a wife who does not believe, and she is happy to stay married to him, he must not divorce her.

fr.L: Mais aux autres je dis, moi, non le Seigneur : si quelque frère a une femme incroyante, et qu’elle consent à habiter avec lui, qu’il ne la quitte pas.
fr.B: Aux autres, c’est moi qui le dis, ce n’est pas une parole du Seigneur : si un frère a une femme qui ne croit pas, et qu’elle est d’accord pour continuer à vivre avec lui, il ne doit pas divorcer d’elle.
fr.R: Aux autres, je dis ceci. C’est ma parole à moi, pas un ordre du Seigneur. Si un homme croyant a une femme qui ne croit pas, et qu’elle est heureuse de rester mariée avec lui, il ne doit pas divorcer d’elle.

es.L: Pero a los demás les digo yo, no el Señor: si algún hermano tiene una mujer no creyente, y ella consiente en vivir con él, que no la deje.
es.B: A todos los demás les digo esto yo mismo; no es una palabra del Señor. Supongamos que un hermano tiene una mujer que no es creyente, y ella está conforme con seguir viviendo con él: él no debe divorciarse de ella.
es.R: A los demás {{plural_you:les|os}} digo esto. Es mi propia palabra, no un mandato del Señor. Si un hombre creyente tiene una esposa que no cree, y ella está contenta de seguir casada con él, él no debe divorciarse de ella.

sw.L: Lakini kwa wengine nasema mimi, si Bwana: kama ndugu yeyote ana mke asiyeamini, naye anakubali kuishi pamoja naye, asimwache.
sw.B: Kwa wengine wote nasema mimi mwenyewe; si neno kutoka kwa Bwana. Tuseme ndugu ana mke asiyeamini, na mke huyo yuko radhi kuendelea kuishi naye: asimtaliki.
sw.R: Kwa ninyi wengine nasema hivi. Ni neno langu mwenyewe, si amri kutoka kwa Bwana. Ikiwa mwanamume aliye mwamini ana mke asiyeamini, na mke huyo anafurahi kuendelea kuishi naye katika ndoa, asimtaliki.

vi.L: Còn với những người khác, chính tôi nói, không phải Chúa: nếu một người anh em nào có vợ không tin, và người vợ ấy bằng lòng sống với anh ta, thì anh ta đừng bỏ vợ.
vi.B: Với những người còn lại, chính tôi nói điều này, đây không phải là lời của Chúa. Giả sử có một người anh em có vợ không tin Chúa, và người vợ ấy bằng lòng tiếp tục sống với anh, thì anh không được ly dị vợ.
vi.R: Với những người còn lại, tôi nói điều này. Đây là lời của riêng tôi, không phải mệnh lệnh của Chúa. Nếu một người đàn ông là tín hữu có vợ không tin Chúa, và người vợ ấy vui lòng tiếp tục sống với chồng, thì người chồng không được ly dị vợ.

ko.L: 나머지 사람들에게는 주님이 아니라 내가 말합니다. 어떤 형제에게 믿지 않는 아내가 있는데, 그 여자가 그와 함께 살기를 좋아하면, 그는 아내를 버리지 마십시오.
ko.B: 그 밖의 사람들에게는 주님께서 하신 말씀이 아니라 내가 말합니다. 어떤 형제에게 믿지 않는 아내가 있는데, 그 아내가 계속 그와 함께 살기를 원하면, 그는 아내와 이혼하지 말아야 합니다.
ko.R: 그 밖의 사람들에게는 내가 말합니다. 이것은 주님의 명령이 아니라 내 말입니다. 믿는 남자에게 믿지 않는 아내가 있는데, 그 아내가 그와 함께 살기를 원하면, 그는 아내와 이혼해서는 안 됩니다.

pt.L: Mas aos demais digo eu, não o Senhor: se algum irmão tem mulher descrente, e ela consente em morar com ele, não a deixe.
pt.B: Aos outros digo eu mesmo; não é uma palavra do Senhor. Suponham que um irmão tenha uma esposa que não crê, e ela esteja de acordo em continuar vivendo com ele: ele não deve se divorciar dela.
pt.R: Aos outros eu digo o seguinte. É uma palavra minha, não uma ordem do Senhor. Se um homem que crê tem uma esposa que não crê, e ela quer continuar casada com ele, ele não deve se divorciar dela.

am.L: ለሌሎቹ ግን እኔ እላለሁ፣ ጌታ አይደለም፤ ማንም ወንድም የማታምን ሚስት ቢኖረው፣ እርሷም ከእርሱ ጋር ለመኖር ብትስማማ፣ አይተዋት።
am.B: ለቀሩት ደግሞ ይህን የምለው እኔ ራሴ ነኝ፤ ከጌታ የመጣ ቃል አይደለም። አንድ ወንድም የማታምን ሚስት ቢኖረውና እርሷም ከእርሱ ጋር መኖርን ብትፈቅድ፣ አይፍታት።
am.R: ለቀራችሁት ይህን እላለሁ። ይህ የራሴ ቃል ነው እንጂ ከጌታ የመጣ ትእዛዝ አይደለም። አንድ አማኝ ወንድ የማታምን ሚስት ቢኖረውና እርሷም ከእርሱ ጋር በትዳር መኖር ደስ ቢላት፣ ሊፈታት አይገባም።

hi.L: पर बाक़ी लोगों से मैं कहता हूँ, मैं, प्रभु नहीं: यदि किसी भाई की पत्नी अविश्वासी हो, और वह उसके साथ रहने को राज़ी हो, तो वह उसे न छोड़े।
hi.B: बाक़ी सब से मैं यह अपनी ओर से कहता हूँ; यह प्रभु का वचन नहीं। मान लो किसी भाई की पत्नी विश्वास नहीं करती, और वह उसके साथ रहते रहने से संतुष्ट है: तो वह उसे तलाक़ न दे।
hi.R: तुममें से बाक़ी लोगों से मैं यह कहता हूँ। यह मेरी अपनी बात है, प्रभु की आज्ञा नहीं। यदि किसी विश्वासी पुरुष की पत्नी विश्वास नहीं करती, और वह उसके साथ विवाहित रहने से ख़ुश है, तो वह उसे तलाक़ न दे।

ru.L: Остальным же говорю я, не Господь: если какой-нибудь брат имеет неверующую жену, и она согласна жить с ним, пусть не оставляет её.
ru.B: Всем остальным я говорю это сам; это не слово Господа. Допустим, у брата есть жена, которая не верит, и она согласна и дальше жить с ним: пусть он не разводится с ней.
ru.R: Остальным я говорю вот что. Это моё собственное слово, а не повеление Господа. Если у верующего мужчины есть жена, которая не верит, и она хочет остаться с ним в браке, пусть он не разводится с ней.

uk.L: А іншим кажу я, не Господь: якщо якийсь брат має дружину невіруючу, і вона згодна жити з ним, нехай не відпускає її.
uk.B: Усім іншим я кажу це сам; це не слово від Господа. Припустімо, якийсь брат має дружину, яка не вірує, і вона згодна жити з ним далі: він не повинен розлучатися з нею.
uk.R: Решті з вас я кажу ось що. Це моє власне слово, а не наказ від Господа. Якщо чоловік, який вірує, має дружину, яка не вірує, і вона охоче залишається з ним у шлюбі, він не повинен розлучатися з нею.

ja.L: そのほかの人たちには、主ではなく、わたしが言います。ある兄弟に信者でない妻がいて、その妻が彼と一緒に住むことに同意しているなら、彼は妻を去らせてはいけません。
ja.B: それ以外の人たちには、主の言葉ではなく、わたし自身の言葉として言います。ある兄弟に信仰を持たない妻がいて、妻が彼と一緒に暮らし続けることを喜んでいるなら、彼は妻を離縁してはいけません。
ja.R: そのほかの人たちには、こう言います。これは主の命令ではなく、わたしの言葉です。信者である男の人に、信仰を持たない妻がいて、その妻が結婚生活を続けたいと思っているなら、夫は妻と離婚してはいけません。

decisions.choice: the rest: believers married to unbelievers; I, not the Lord: Jesus left no saying on this case
alternatives: Paul's word carries less authority than the Lord's
decisions.reason: λοιποῖς are those not covered by verses 10-11: couples where only one partner has come to faith. Jesus spoke to married people within God's people; he gave no ruling on this new situation. Paul still speaks with an apostle's authority (verses 17 and 40; 14:37).

decisions.choice: brother: a fellow believer, here a man
decisions.reason: ἀδελφὸς is Paul's usual word for a member of the church. Here it means one particular kind of person, a believing husband; verse 15 names "the brother or the sister".

decisions.choice: unbelieving: not a believer in Christ
decisions.reason: ἄπιστον is used throughout this letter of people outside the church (6:6; 10:27; 14:22-24). It says nothing about the wife's loyalty to her husband.

decisions.choice: a man who is a believer
decisions.reason: Readable says who "brother" means here (m2).

decisions.choice: divorce
decisions.reason: As in verse 11, the verb means ending the marriage. Literal keeps "leave".

decisions.choice: algún hermano, no setting
decisions.reason: Here the brother is a man with a wife (m2), so Spanish has only "hermano", as the English has no gender span.

decisions.choice: "một người anh em", with no gender span, for a particular man
alternatives: the gender span for "anh chị em"
decisions.reason: As the book-wide choice says, no span where a man is meant: here a husband.

decisions.choice: "형제" with no gender span for the believing husband
decisions.reason: The project's choice for these letters gives no gender span where one particular man is meant; here the word means a believing husband.

decisions.choice: "भाई" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The brother here is a believing man, the husband (meaning decision m2), so there is no span, as in the English; Readable says "विश्वासी पुरुष".

decisions.choice: брат (no setting)
decisions.reason: Here "brother" is a believing man, set against the believing wife of verse 13 (m2), so it takes no gender setting.

decisions.choice: брат, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Corinthians note gives no span for a particular man: here the brother is a believing husband (m2).

decisions.choice: "兄弟" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Here a believing man is meant (m2); book terms give no span for a particular man.

source.text: καὶ γυνὴ εἴ τις ἔχει ἄνδρα ἄπιστον, καὶ οὗτος συνευδοκεῖ οἰκεῖν μετ’ αὐτῆς, μὴ ἀφιέτω τὸν ἄνδρα.

records.literal_gloss: And a wife if any has a husband unbelieving, and he consents to live with her, let her not leave the husband.

en.L: And if any wife has an unbelieving husband, and he consents to live with her, let her not leave the husband.
en.B: And if a woman has a husband who does not believe, and he is content to go on living with her, she must not divorce him.
en.R: And if a woman who is a believer has a husband who does not believe, and he is happy to stay married to her, she must not divorce him.

fr.L: Et si quelque femme a un mari incroyant, et qu’il consent à habiter avec elle, qu’elle ne quitte pas le mari.
fr.B: Et si une femme a un mari qui ne croit pas, et qu’il est d’accord pour continuer à vivre avec elle, elle ne doit pas divorcer de lui.
fr.R: Et si une femme croyante a un mari qui ne croit pas, et qu’il est heureux de rester marié avec elle, elle ne doit pas divorcer de lui.

es.L: Y si alguna mujer tiene un marido no creyente, y él consiente en vivir con ella, que no deje al marido.
es.B: Y si una mujer tiene un marido que no es creyente, y él está conforme con seguir viviendo con ella, ella no debe divorciarse de él.
es.R: Y si una mujer creyente tiene un esposo que no cree, y él está contento de seguir casado con ella, ella no debe divorciarse de él.

sw.L: Na mke yeyote akiwa na mume asiyeamini, naye anakubali kuishi pamoja naye, asimwache mume.
sw.B: Na ikiwa mwanamke ana mume asiyeamini, na mume huyo yuko radhi kuendelea kuishi naye, asimwache.
sw.R: Na ikiwa mwanamke aliye mwamini ana mume asiyeamini, na mume huyo anafurahi kuendelea kuishi naye katika ndoa, asimwache.

vi.L: Và nếu một người vợ nào có chồng không tin, và người chồng ấy bằng lòng sống với chị, thì chị đừng bỏ chồng.
vi.B: Và nếu một người phụ nữ có chồng không tin Chúa, và người chồng ấy bằng lòng tiếp tục sống với chị, thì chị không được ly dị chồng.
vi.R: Và nếu một người phụ nữ là tín hữu có chồng không tin Chúa, và người chồng ấy vui lòng tiếp tục sống với vợ, thì người vợ không được ly dị chồng.

ko.L: 또 어떤 아내에게 믿지 않는 남편이 있는데, 그가 그 여자와 함께 살기를 좋아하면, 그 여자는 남편을 버리지 마십시오.
ko.B: 또 어떤 여자에게 믿지 않는 남편이 있는데, 그 남편이 계속 그 여자와 함께 살기를 원하면, 그 여자는 남편과 이혼하지 말아야 합니다.
ko.R: 또 믿는 여자에게 믿지 않는 남편이 있는데, 그 남편이 그 여자와 함께 살기를 원하면, 그 여자는 남편과 이혼해서는 안 됩니다.

pt.L: E, se alguma mulher tem marido descrente, e ele consente em morar com ela, não deixe o marido.
pt.B: E, se uma mulher tem um marido que não crê, e ele está de acordo em continuar vivendo com ela, ela não deve se divorciar dele.
pt.R: E, se uma mulher que crê tem um marido que não crê, e ele quer continuar casado com ela, ela não deve se divorciar dele.

am.L: ሴትም ማንኛዋም የማያምን ባል ቢኖራት፣ እርሱም ከእርሷ ጋር ለመኖር ቢስማማ፣ ባሏን አትተው።
am.B: አንዲት ሴትም የማያምን ባል ቢኖራትና እርሱም ከእርሷ ጋር መኖርን ቢፈቅድ፣ ከእርሱ አትፋታ።
am.R: እንዲሁም አንዲት አማኝ ሴት የማያምን ባል ቢኖራትና እርሱም ከእርሷ ጋር በትዳር መኖር ደስ ቢለው፣ ከእርሱ መፋታት የለባትም።

hi.L: और यदि किसी पत्नी का पति अविश्वासी हो, और वह उसके साथ रहने को राज़ी हो, तो वह पति को न छोड़े।
hi.B: और यदि किसी स्त्री का पति विश्वास नहीं करता, और वह उसके साथ रहते रहने से संतुष्ट है, तो वह उसे तलाक़ न दे।
hi.R: और यदि किसी विश्वासी स्त्री का पति विश्वास नहीं करता, और वह उसके साथ विवाहित रहने से ख़ुश है, तो वह उसे तलाक़ न दे।

ru.L: И если какая-нибудь жена имеет неверующего мужа, и он согласен жить с ней, пусть не оставляет мужа.
ru.B: И если у женщины есть муж, который не верит, и он согласен и дальше жить с ней, пусть она не разводится с ним.
ru.R: И если у верующей женщины есть муж, который не верит, и он хочет остаться с ней в браке, пусть она не разводится с ним.

uk.L: І якщо якась жінка має чоловіка невіруючого, і він згодний жити з нею, нехай не відпускає чоловіка.
uk.B: І якщо якась жінка має чоловіка, який не вірує, і він згодний жити з нею далі, вона не повинна розлучатися з ним.
uk.R: І якщо жінка, яка вірує, має чоловіка, який не вірує, і він охоче залишається з нею у шлюбі, вона не повинна розлучатися з ним.

ja.L: また、ある妻に信者でない夫がいて、その夫が彼女と一緒に住むことに同意しているなら、妻は夫を去らせてはいけません。
ja.B: また、ある女の人に信仰を持たない夫がいて、夫が彼女と一緒に暮らし続けることを喜んでいるなら、彼女は夫を離縁してはいけません。
ja.R: また、信者である女の人に、信仰を持たない夫がいて、その夫が結婚生活を続けたいと思っているなら、妻は夫と離婚してはいけません。

decisions.choice: let her not leave: a wife could end a marriage too
decisions.reason: Under Roman law a wife, as well as a husband, could divorce. Here Paul uses for the wife the same verb, ἀφιέτω, that he used for the husband in verse 12, and gives her the same rule.

decisions.choice: a wife: a believing wife, matching the "brother" of verse 12
decisions.reason: The parallel with verse 12 shows that she is a believer, as verse 14 confirms.

decisions.choice: divorce him
decisions.reason: As in verse 12; Literal keeps "leave" and repeats "the husband" as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: asimwache
decisions.reason: The English says "divorce him"; Swahili "kutaliki" is said of a husband, so the wife's ending of the marriage is "kumwacha" (leave him), which the meaning decision's point (a wife could end a marriage too) still carries.

source.text: ἡγίασται γὰρ ὁ ἀνὴρ ὁ ἄπιστος ἐν τῇ γυναικί, καὶ ἡγίασται ἡ γυνὴ ἡ ἄπιστος ἐν τῷ ἀδελφῷ· ἐπεὶ ἄρα τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν ἀκάθαρτά ἐστιν, νῦν δὲ ἅγιά ἐστιν.

records.literal_gloss: Has been made holy for the husband the unbelieving in the wife, and has been made holy the wife the unbelieving in the brother; since then the children of you unclean are, but now holy they are.

en.L: For the unbelieving husband has been made holy in the wife, and the unbelieving wife has been made holy in the brother; since otherwise your children are unclean, but now they are holy.
en.B: For through his wife the husband who does not believe has been made holy, and through the brother she is married to, the wife who does not believe has been made holy. If it were not so, your children would be unclean; in fact, they are holy.
en.R: A husband who does not believe is made holy because of his wife, who believes. And a wife who does not believe is made holy because of her husband, who believes. If this were not true, your children would be unclean, not set apart for God. But they are holy.

fr.L: Car le mari incroyant a été sanctifié dans la femme, et la femme incroyante a été sanctifiée dans le frère ; autrement vos enfants sont impurs, mais maintenant ils sont saints.
fr.B: Car le mari qui ne croit pas a été rendu saint par sa femme, et la femme qui ne croit pas a été rendue sainte par le frère qu’elle a épousé. S’il n’en était pas ainsi, vos enfants seraient impurs ; en réalité, ils sont saints.
fr.R: Un mari qui ne croit pas est rendu saint grâce à sa femme, qui croit. Et une femme qui ne croit pas est rendue sainte grâce à son mari, qui croit. Si ce n’était pas vrai, vos enfants seraient impurs, ils ne seraient pas mis à part pour Dieu. Mais ils sont saints.

es.L: Porque el marido no creyente ha sido santificado en la mujer, y la mujer no creyente ha sido santificada en el hermano; pues de otro modo {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos serían impuros, pero ahora son santos.
es.B: Porque el marido no creyente ha sido santificado por medio de su mujer, y la mujer no creyente ha sido santificada por medio del hermano con quien está casada. Si no fuera así, {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos serían impuros; pero, de hecho, son santos.
es.R: Un esposo que no cree queda santificado gracias a su esposa, que sí cree. Y una esposa que no cree queda santificada gracias a su esposo, que sí cree. Si esto no fuera así, {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos serían impuros, no apartados para Dios. Pero son santos.

sw.L: Kwa maana mume asiyeamini ametakaswa katika mke, na mke asiyeamini ametakaswa katika ndugu; kwa kuwa vinginevyo watoto wenu ni najisi, lakini sasa ni watakatifu.
sw.B: Kwa maana mume asiyeamini ametakaswa kupitia mkewe, na mke asiyeamini ametakaswa kupitia ndugu aliyemwoa. Kama sivyo, watoto wenu wangekuwa najisi; lakini kwa kweli wao ni watakatifu.
sw.R: Mume asiyeamini anafanywa mtakatifu kwa sababu ya mkewe, aliye mwamini. Na mke asiyeamini anafanywa mtakatifu kwa sababu ya mumewe, aliye mwamini. Kama hili lisingekuwa kweli, watoto wenu wangekuwa najisi, wasiotengwa kwa ajili ya Mungu. Lakini wao ni watakatifu.

vi.L: Vì người chồng không tin đã được nên thánh trong người vợ, và người vợ không tin đã được nên thánh trong người anh em; nếu không thì con cái anh chị em là ô uế, nhưng bây giờ chúng là thánh.
vi.B: Vì qua người vợ, người chồng không tin Chúa đã được nên thánh; và qua người anh em là chồng mình, người vợ không tin Chúa đã được nên thánh. Nếu không như vậy, con cái anh chị em là ô uế; nhưng thật ra chúng là thánh.
vi.R: Người chồng không tin Chúa được nên thánh nhờ người vợ là tín hữu. Và người vợ không tin Chúa được nên thánh nhờ người chồng là tín hữu. Nếu không như vậy, con cái anh chị em sẽ là ô uế, không được biệt riêng cho Đức Chúa Trời. Nhưng chúng là thánh.

ko.L: 믿지 않는 남편은 아내 안에서 거룩하게 되었고, 믿지 않는 아내는 형제 안에서 거룩하게 되었기 때문입니다. 그렇지 않으면 여러분의 자녀도 깨끗하지 못할 것이지만, 이제 그들은 거룩합니다.
ko.B: 믿지 않는 남편은 아내를 통해 거룩하게 되었고, 믿지 않는 아내는 믿는 남편을 통해 거룩하게 되었기 때문입니다. 그렇지 않다면 여러분의 자녀도 깨끗하지 못할 것입니다. 그러나 사실 그들은 거룩합니다.
ko.R: 믿지 않는 남편은 믿는 아내 덕분에 거룩하게 됩니다. 믿지 않는 아내는 믿는 남편 덕분에 거룩하게 됩니다. 그렇지 않다면 여러분의 자녀들도 깨끗하지 않아서 하나님께 구별되지 못할 것입니다. 그러나 여러분의 자녀들은 거룩합니다.

pt.L: Pois o marido descrente foi santificado na mulher, e a mulher descrente foi santificada no irmão; senão, os filhos de vocês seriam impuros, mas agora são santos.
pt.B: Pois, por meio da esposa, o marido que não crê foi santificado, e, por meio do irmão com quem está casada, a esposa que não crê foi santificada. Se não fosse assim, os filhos de vocês seriam impuros; mas, de fato, eles são santos.
pt.R: O marido que não crê se torna santo por causa da esposa, que crê. E a esposa que não crê se torna santa por causa do marido, que crê. Se isso não fosse verdade, os filhos de vocês seriam impuros, não separados para Deus. Mas eles são santos.

am.L: የማያምነው ባል በሚስቲቱ ተቀድሷልና፤ የማታምነዋም ሚስት በወንድም ተቀድሳለች፤ ያለዚያማ ልጆቻችሁ ርኩሳን ናቸው፤ አሁን ግን ቅዱሳን ናቸው።
am.B: የማያምነው ባል በሚስቱ በኩል ተቀድሷልና፤ የማታምነዋም ሚስት ባሏ በሆነው ወንድም በኩል ተቀድሳለች። እንዲህ ባይሆን ኖሮ ልጆቻችሁ ርኩሳን በሆኑ ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ቅዱሳን ናቸው።
am.R: የማያምን ባል ከምታምነው ሚስቱ የተነሣ ተቀድሷል። የማታምን ሚስትም ከሚያምነው ባሏ የተነሣ ተቀድሳለች። ይህ እውነት ባይሆን ኖሮ ልጆቻችሁ ርኩሳን፣ ለእግዚአብሔር ያልተለዩ በሆኑ ነበር። አሁን ግን ቅዱሳን ናቸው።

hi.L: क्योंकि अविश्वासी पति पत्नी में पवित्र किया गया है, और अविश्वासी पत्नी भाई में पवित्र की गई है; नहीं तो तुम्हारे बच्चे अशुद्ध होते, पर अब वे पवित्र हैं।
hi.B: क्योंकि जो पति विश्वास नहीं करता, वह अपनी पत्नी के द्वारा पवित्र किया गया है, और जो पत्नी विश्वास नहीं करती, वह उस भाई के द्वारा जिससे उसका विवाह हुआ है, पवित्र की गई है। यदि ऐसा न होता, तो तुम्हारे बच्चे अशुद्ध होते; पर सच तो यह है कि वे पवित्र हैं।
hi.R: जो पति विश्वास नहीं करता, वह अपनी पत्नी के कारण, जो विश्वास करती है, पवित्र ठहरता है। और जो पत्नी विश्वास नहीं करती, वह अपने पति के कारण, जो विश्वास करता है, पवित्र ठहरती है। यदि यह सच न होता, तो तुम्हारे बच्चे अशुद्ध होते, परमेश्वर के लिए अलग किए हुए नहीं। पर वे पवित्र हैं।

ru.L: Ведь освящён неверующий муж в жене, и освящена неверующая жена в брате; иначе ваши дети нечисты, а теперь они святы.
ru.B: Ведь неверующий муж освящён через свою жену, и неверующая жена освящена через брата, за которым она замужем. Иначе ваши дети были бы нечистыми, а на самом деле они святы.
ru.R: Муж, который не верит, освящается благодаря своей жене, которая верит. И жена, которая не верит, освящается благодаря своему мужу, который верит. Если бы это было не так, ваши дети были бы нечистыми, не отделёнными для Бога. Но они святы.

uk.L: Бо освячений невіруючий чоловік у дружині, і освячена невіруюча дружина в брату; інакше ваші діти були б нечисті, а тепер вони святі.
uk.B: Бо невіруючий чоловік освячений через свою дружину, і невіруюча дружина освячена через брата, за яким вона заміжня. Якби не це, ваші діти були б нечисті, а насправді вони святі.
uk.R: Чоловік, який не вірує, освячується завдяки своїй дружині, яка вірує. І дружина, яка не вірує, освячується завдяки своєму чоловікові, який вірує. Якби це було не так, ваші діти були б нечисті, не відокремлені для Бога. Але вони святі.

ja.L: なぜなら、信者でない夫は妻において聖なる者とされており、信者でない妻は兄弟において聖なる者とされているからです。そうでなければ、あなたがたの子どもたちは汚れていることになりますが、実際には聖なる者なのです。
ja.B: 信仰を持たない夫は妻によって聖なる者とされ、信仰を持たない妻は、夫である兄弟によって聖なる者とされているからです。そうでなければ、あなたがたの子どもたちは汚れていることになります。しかし実際には、子どもたちは聖なる者なのです。
ja.R: 信仰を持たない夫は、信じている妻のおかげで、聖なる者とされます。信仰を持たない妻も、信じている夫のおかげで、聖なる者とされます。もしそうでなかったら、みなさんの子どもたちは汚れていて、神のために取り分けられていないことになります。でも、子どもたちは聖なる者なのです。

decisions.choice: made holy: set apart and brought within the reach of God's holiness through the marriage, but not saved
alternatives: saved, or made a Christian, through the believing spouse
the marriage is acceptable to God
decisions.reason: ἡγίασται is the verb used in 1:2 and 6:11 of believers. But verse 16 shows that the unbelieving partner is not yet saved. Some in Corinth may have feared that union with an unbeliever made the believer unclean, as union with a prostitute did (6:15-17). Paul answers that the influence runs the other way: holiness reaches from the believer to the spouse and the home. How far this goes is not spelled out.

decisions.choice: in the wife, in the brother: by being joined to the believing spouse
decisions.reason: ἐν here gives the sphere or means: through the marriage bond with a believer.

decisions.choice: otherwise your children would be unclean: an argument from what the church already accepted
decisions.reason: ἐπεὶ ἄρα means "since otherwise". Paul assumes his readers already count the children of a believing parent as belonging to God; the same must then be true of the unbelieving spouse. "Unclean" and "holy" are the Old Testament terms for what may or may not come near God.

decisions.choice: through (B); because of (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek "in" means by virtue of the union (m2); Literal keeps "in".

decisions.choice: the brother she is married to (B); her husband, who believes (R); not set apart for God (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced makes clear that "the brother" is the believing husband; Readable says so plainly and says what "unclean" means.

decisions.choice: sanctifié (L); rendu saint (B, R), as in 6:11
decisions.reason: The same verb as in 6:11 gets the same French, so that the reader can see the link; "rendu saint" also keeps the word "saints" used of the children at the end of the verse.

decisions.choice: serían impuros
decisions.reason: The Greek says "are unclean" after "since otherwise", an unreal condition. Spanish needs the conditional "serían" there, even at Literal, to be grammatical.

decisions.choice: najisi
decisions.reason: "Najisi" is unclean in the religious sense, set against "watakatifu" (holy); "wachafu" would suggest dirt.

decisions.choice: "được nên thánh" for hagiazo and "ô uế" / "thánh" for the children
decisions.reason: The verb of 1:2 and 6:11, so that the reader sees it is the same word, while m1 says it does not mean that the spouse is saved. "Ô uế" is the word of the Vietnamese Romans 14:14 for what is unclean.

decisions.choice: "거룩하게 되다" for the verb, the verb of 1:2 and 6:11; "깨끗하지 못하다" for unclean
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as being set apart within the reach of God's holiness, not as being saved; Korean keeps the same verb as in 1:2 so the link is seen, and the meaning decision says what it means here.

decisions.choice: senão, os filhos de vocês seriam impuros
alternatives: pois então os filhos de vocês são impuros

decisions.reason: Amharic keeps the Greek's holiness word, which links to "ቅዱሳን" (holy) at the end of the verse; it must not read as "saved" (m1, and verse 16).

decisions.reason: Set apart through the marriage, but not saved (m1, uncertain, footnoted); the wording does not say more.

source.text: εἰ δὲ ὁ ἄπιστος χωρίζεται, χωριζέσθω· οὐ δεδούλωται ὁ ἀδελφὸς ἢ ἡ ἀδελφὴ ἐν τοῖς τοιούτοις, ἐν δὲ εἰρήνῃ κέκληκεν ἡμᾶς ὁ θεός.

records.literal_gloss: If but the unbelieving separates, let him separate; not has been enslaved the brother or the sister in the such [cases], in but peace has called us the God.

en.L: But if the unbeliever separates, let [that one] separate; the brother or the sister has not been enslaved in such [cases]; but God has called us in peace.
en.B: But if the one who does not believe chooses to separate, let the separation happen. A brother or a sister is not bound in circumstances like these. It is in peace that God has called us.
en.R: But if the husband or wife who does not believe wants to leave, let it happen. In that case the believing husband or wife is not tied to the marriage. God called us so that we would live at peace.

fr.L: Mais si l’incroyant se sépare, qu’il se sépare ; le frère ou la sœur n’est pas asservi dans de tels [cas] ; mais Dieu nous a appelés dans la paix.
fr.B: Mais si celui qui ne croit pas choisit de se séparer, qu’il le fasse. Dans ces cas-là, le frère ou la sœur n’est pas lié. C’est dans la paix que Dieu nous a appelés.
fr.R: Mais si le mari ou la femme qui ne croit pas veut partir, acceptez son départ. Dans ce cas, le mari ou la femme qui croit n’est plus attaché à ce mariage. Dieu nous a appelés pour que nous vivions en paix.

es.L: Pero si el no creyente se separa, que se separe; el hermano o la hermana no ha sido esclavizado en [casos] semejantes; pero Dios nos ha llamado en paz.
es.B: Pero si el que no es creyente decide separarse, que se separe. En casos como estos, el hermano o la hermana no está atado. Es en paz como Dios nos ha llamado.
es.R: Pero si el esposo o la esposa que no cree quiere irse, que se vaya. En ese caso, el esposo o la esposa que cree no está atado al matrimonio. Dios nos llamó para que vivamos en paz.

sw.L: Lakini kama asiyeamini anatengana, na atengane; ndugu wa kiume au ndugu wa kike hajafanywa mtumwa katika [mambo] kama hayo; lakini Mungu ametuita katika amani.
sw.B: Lakini ikiwa yule asiyeamini anaamua kutengana, waache watengane. Ndugu wa kiume au wa kike hafungwi katika hali kama hizo. Mungu ametuita katika amani.
sw.R: Lakini ikiwa mume au mke asiyeamini anataka kuondoka, mwache aondoke. Katika hali hiyo, mume au mke aliye mwamini hafungwi na ndoa hiyo. Mungu alituita ili tuishi kwa amani.

vi.L: Nhưng nếu người không tin muốn ly thân, thì hãy để [người ấy] ly thân; trong những trường hợp như thế, người anh em hay người chị em không bị làm nô lệ; nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã kêu gọi chúng ta trong sự bình an.
vi.B: Nhưng nếu người không tin Chúa muốn ly thân, thì hãy để việc ly thân xảy ra. Trong những trường hợp như vậy, người anh em hay người chị em không bị ràng buộc. Đức Chúa Trời đã kêu gọi chúng ta để sống trong bình an.
vi.R: Nhưng nếu người chồng hay người vợ không tin Chúa muốn bỏ đi, thì hãy để việc đó xảy ra. Trong trường hợp ấy, người chồng hay người vợ là tín hữu không còn bị buộc phải giữ cuộc hôn nhân đó. Đức Chúa Trời đã kêu gọi chúng ta để sống hòa thuận.

ko.L: 그러나 믿지 않는 사람이 갈라서면 갈라서게 하십시오. 이런 경우에는 형제나 자매가 종노릇 하는 것이 아닙니다. 하나님께서는 평화 가운데로 우리를 부르셨습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 믿지 않는 쪽이 떠나려고 하면 떠나게 하십시오. 이런 경우에 믿는 형제나 자매는 얽매이지 않습니다. 하나님께서는 우리를 평화 가운데로 부르셨습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 믿지 않는 남편이나 아내가 떠나려고 하면 떠나게 하십시오. 그런 경우에는 믿는 남편이나 아내가 그 결혼에 묶여 있지 않습니다. 하나님께서는 우리가 평화롭게 살도록 부르셨습니다.

pt.L: Mas, se o descrente se separa, que se separe; o irmão ou a irmã não foi escravizado em tais [casos]; mas Deus nos chamou em paz.
pt.B: Mas, se quem não crê decide se separar, que a separação aconteça. Nesses casos, o irmão ou a irmã não está preso. Foi em paz que Deus nos chamou.
pt.R: Mas, se o marido ou a esposa que não crê quer ir embora, que vá. Nesse caso, o marido ou a esposa que crê não fica preso ao casamento. Deus nos chamou para vivermos em paz.

am.L: የማያምነው ግን ቢለይ ይለይ፤ በእንደዚህ ያሉ [ነገሮች] ወንድም ወይም እኅት ባሪያዎች አልተደረጉም፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን በሰላም ጠርቶናል።
am.B: የማያምነው ግን መለየትን ቢመርጥ ይለይ። በእንደዚህ ዓይነቱ ሁኔታ ወንድም ወይም እኅት የታሰሩ አይደሉም። እግዚአብሔር የጠራን በሰላም ነው።

hi.L: पर यदि अविश्वासी अलग हो, तो अलग हो जाए; ऐसी [दशाओं] में भाई या बहन दास नहीं बनाए गए हैं; पर परमेश्वर ने हमें शान्ति में बुलाया है।
hi.B: पर यदि जो विश्वास नहीं करता, वह अलग होना चाहे, तो उसे अलग होने दो। ऐसी परिस्थितियों में कोई भाई या बहन बंधा हुआ नहीं है। परमेश्वर ने हमें शान्ति में बुलाया है।
hi.R: पर यदि वह पति या पत्नी, जो विश्वास नहीं करता, छोड़ना चाहे, तो उसे जाने दो। ऐसे में विश्वासी पति या पत्नी उस विवाह से बंधा नहीं है। परमेश्वर ने हमें इसलिए बुलाया है कि हम शान्ति से जिएँ।

ru.L: Если же неверующий разлучается, пусть разлучается; брат или сестра в таких [случаях] не порабощены; но в мире призвал нас Бог.
ru.B: Но если неверующий хочет разойтись, пусть расходится. Брат или сестра в таких обстоятельствах не связаны. Бог призвал нас к жизни в мире.
ru.R: Но если муж или жена, которые не верят, хотят уйти, пусть уходят. В этом случае верующий муж или верующая жена не привязаны к этому браку. Бог призвал нас для того, чтобы мы жили в мире.

uk.L: А якщо невіруючий відходить, нехай відходить; не поневолений брат чи сестра в таких [випадках]; а до миру покликав нас Бог.
uk.B: Але якщо той, хто не вірує, вирішує відійти, нехай відходить. Брат чи сестра в таких обставинах не звʼязані. Бог покликав нас жити в мирі.
uk.R: Але якщо чоловік чи дружина, які не вірують, хочуть піти, нехай ідуть. У такому разі той, хто вірує, не привʼязаний до цього шлюбу. Бог покликав нас, щоб ми жили в мирі.

ja.L: しかし、信者でない者が別れて行くなら、別れさせなさい。そのような場合、兄弟も姉妹も奴隷にされてはいません。神はわたしたちを平和のうちに召されたのです。
ja.B: しかし、信仰を持たない相手が別れようとするなら、別れさせなさい。こういう場合、兄弟も姉妹も縛られてはいません。神がわたしたちを召されたのは、平和のうちに生きるためです。
ja.R: でも、信仰を持たない夫や妻が出て行きたいと言うなら、そうさせてください。その場合、信じている夫や妻は、その結婚に縛られてはいません。神がわたしたちを召されたのは、わたしたちが平和に暮らすためです。

decisions.choice: separates: chooses to end the marriage; let it happen
decisions.reason: χωρίζεται is the same verb as in verses 10-11, here of the unbelieving partner's own choice. χωριζέσθω tells the believer not to resist it.

decisions.choice: not bound: not obliged to hold the marriage together
alternatives: not enslaved to the unbeliever's wishes
decisions.reason: δεδούλωται means "has been enslaved", a strong word. The believer is not bound to keep a marriage the other has ended. Whether this also leaves the believer free to marry again is not stated; the text does not repeat the "stay unmarried" of verse 11, which some take as permission, while others hold that verse 39 still applies.

decisions.choice: God has called us in peace: a reason for letting the unbeliever go, rather than holding on at all costs
alternatives: a reason to keep the marriage if at all possible, leading into verse 16
decisions.reason: δὲ can mark a contrast or carry the thought on. Following "not bound", peace most naturally explains why the believer need not fight the separation. Others connect it with verse 16 as a call to keep the peace in the marriage.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "us"
decisions.reason: Some important manuscripts read "you" instead of "us". The two words differed by one letter and sounded alike, so copyists often confused them. The meaning is little changed. Reviewers must check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: has not been enslaved (L); is not bound (B); is not tied to the marriage (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the strong verb; Balanced and Readable give its sense here (m2).

decisions.choice: le frère ou la sœur, with no setting
decisions.reason: The Greek itself names both the brother and the sister, so French says both and needs no gender span. The generic "l’incroyant" and "celui qui ne croit pas" cover a husband or a wife.

decisions.choice: no ha sido esclavizado (L); no está atado (B); no está atado al matrimonio (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the slave picture of the Greek verb; Balanced and Readable say "atado", tied, as the English says "bound". The masculine participle agrees with "el hermano o la hermana" together, as Spanish does for a man and a woman named side by side.

decisions.choice: ndugu wa kiume au ndugu wa kike (L); ndugu wa kiume au wa kike (B)
decisions.reason: "Ndugu" alone covers both, but Paul names the brother and the sister separately, so Swahili spells out both.

decisions.choice: "không bị làm nô lệ" (L); "không bị ràng buộc" (B); "không còn bị buộc phải giữ cuộc hôn nhân đó" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of slavery, as the English does; "người anh em hay người chị em" names both, with no gender span, since the Greek names both.

decisions.choice: "종노릇 하다" (L); "얽매이다" (B); "결혼에 묶여 있다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the strong picture of the Greek, "has been enslaved", with the phrase Romans 6:6 (L) uses; Balanced and Readable give the sense. "형제나 자매" names both, with no gender span.

decisions.choice: "평화" for peace between people here
decisions.reason: "평안" is kept for the peace God gives in the greetings; peace in a household is "평화", as in Romans 12:18.

decisions.choice: "दास नहीं बनाए गए" (L); "बंधा हुआ नहीं" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the strong verb, enslaved; Balanced and Readable give its sense, not obliged to hold the marriage together (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: не порабощены (L); не связаны (B); не привязаны к этому браку (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the strong verb, "enslaved"; Balanced and Readable give its sense here (m2).

decisions.choice: не поневолений
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is "enslaved", and the English Literal keeps it; "поневолений" keeps the slave picture that runs on into 7:21-23.

decisions.choice: "奴隷にされて" (L); "縛られて" (B); "その結婚に縛られて" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (enslaved, bound, tied); m2 is uncertain and footnoted.

decisions.choice: "平和"
decisions.reason: Peace between people in the home, not the greeting or inner peace (style table).

ja.B: 妻よ、あなたが夫を救えるかどうか、どうしてわかるでしょうか？
ja.R: 妻であるあなたは、夫があなたを通して救われるかどうか、どうしてわかるのですか？

decisions.choice: how do you know whether ...: you cannot be sure that staying will lead to your spouse's salvation
alternatives: perhaps you will save your spouse, so try to keep the marriage
decisions.reason: γὰρ links the question to verse 15. Read that way, Paul tells the believer not to hold on to an unwilling partner in the hope of winning them, since no one can know that. The question can also be heard hopefully, "who knows, you may save him", as a reason to stay (verses 12-13). The Greek allows both.

decisions.choice: save: bring the spouse to salvation, through faith in Christ
decisions.reason: σώσεις means to save in the full sense (1:18, 21). Paul speaks of the believer being the means of it (9:22); being made holy (verse 14) is not the same as being saved.

decisions.choice: your husband will be saved through you
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the wife is the means of his salvation, not its source.

decisions.choice: tu (every level)
decisions.reason: Paul turns to one wife, and then to one husband, with a singular verb, so French says "tu", as the style guide sets for one addressee.

decisions.choice: sabes (tú), no plural_you setting
decisions.reason: Paul turns to one wife and then to one husband in the singular, so Spanish uses "tú", which needs no ustedes/vosotros setting.

decisions.choice: "hỡi người vợ" (L), "hỡi người làm vợ" (B, R), with "bạn" for the singular "you" (7:16, 7:21, 7:27-28)
decisions.reason: Paul turns to one wife and one husband in the singular; as in the Vietnamese Romans, "bạn" is the plain singular. The address takes "hỡi" because it names a type of person, not the readers as family, as "người làm vợ" does in the Vietnamese Ephesians.

decisions.choice: "아내여" (L); "아내 된 사람이여" (B, R) with "당신" in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: Paul turns to one wife and then one husband; the singular "you" is "당신" in the polite style of the letter, as in 4:7.

decisions.choice: você, mulher
decisions.reason: Paul turns to one reader with a singular verb, so Portuguese says "você", as between people anywhere in the letter. The vocative is "mulher", the ordinary way to call on a wife; "esposa" is not used as a form of address.

decisions.choice: "妻よ" (L, B); "妻であるあなたは" (R); likewise "夫よ" in the next sentence
decisions.reason: A plain address to one wife; Readable avoids the old vocative "よ".

source.text: ἢ τί οἶδας, ἄνερ, εἰ τὴν γυναῖκα σώσεις;

es.B: ¿O cómo puedes saber, marido, si salvarás a tu mujer?
es.R: Y tú, esposo, ¿cómo sabes si tu esposa se salvará por medio de ti?

sw.L: Au unajuaje, mume, kama utamwokoa mke?
sw.B: Au wewe mume, unawezaje kujua kama utamwokoa mkeo?
sw.R: Na wewe mume, unajuaje kama mkeo ataokolewa kupitia kwako?

vi.L: Hay hỡi người chồng, làm sao bạn biết bạn sẽ cứu được vợ mình?
vi.B: Hay hỡi người làm chồng, làm sao bạn biết chắc là bạn sẽ cứu được vợ mình?
vi.R: Còn người làm chồng, làm sao bạn biết vợ mình sẽ được cứu nhờ bạn?

ko.L: 남편이여, 당신이 아내를 구원할지 어떻게 알겠습니까?
ko.B: 남편 된 사람이여, 당신이 아내를 구원할 수 있을지 어떻게 알겠습니까?
ko.R: 남편 된 사람이여, 당신을 통해 아내가 구원을 받을지 어떻게 알겠습니까?

pt.B: Ou como você pode saber, marido, se vai salvar a sua esposa?
pt.R: E você, marido, como sabe se a sua esposa vai ser salva por meio de você?

hi.R: और हे पति, तुम कैसे जानते हो कि तुम्हारे द्वारा तुम्हारी पत्नी का उद्धार होगा?

ru.L: Или откуда ты знаешь, муж, спасёшь ли ты жену?
ru.B: Или как ты можешь знать, муж, спасёшь ли ты свою жену?
ru.R: И муж, откуда тебе знать, будет ли твоя жена спасена через тебя?

uk.L: Або звідки ти знаєш, чоловіче, чи спасеш дружину?
uk.B: Або звідки тобі знати, чоловіче, чи ти спасеш свою дружину?
uk.R: І ти, чоловіче, звідки знаєш, чи твоя дружина буде спасена через тебе?

ja.L: あるいは、夫よ、あなたが妻を救うかどうか、どうしてわかるのですか？
ja.B: また、夫よ、あなたが妻を救えるかどうか、どうしてわかるでしょうか？
ja.R: また、夫であるあなたは、妻があなたを通して救われるかどうか、どうしてわかるのですか？

decisions.reason: As in 16a.

source.text: Εἰ μὴ ἑκάστῳ ὡς ἐμέρισεν ὁ κύριος, ἕκαστον ὡς κέκληκεν ὁ θεός, οὕτως περιπατείτω· καὶ οὕτως ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις πάσαις διατάσσομαι.

records.literal_gloss: Except to each as has assigned the Lord, each as has called the God, so let him walk; and so in the churches all I direct.

en.L: Only, as the Lord has assigned to each, as God has called each, so let each walk. And so I direct in all the churches.
en.B: Whatever the case, each of you should lead the life the Lord has given you, the life you had when God called you. I give this same direction in every church.
en.R: But each of you should keep living the life the Lord has given you. Stay in the situation you were in when God called you. This is what I teach in all the churches.

fr.L: Seulement, chacun, comme le Seigneur [lui] a donné sa part, chacun, comme Dieu [l’]a appelé, qu’il marche ainsi. Et c’est ce que je prescris dans toutes les églises.
fr.B: Quoi qu’il en soit, que chacun de vous mène la vie que le Seigneur lui a donnée, la vie qu’il avait quand Dieu l’a appelé. C’est la même règle que je donne dans toutes les églises.
fr.R: Mais chacun de vous doit continuer à vivre la vie que le Seigneur lui a donnée. Restez dans la situation où vous étiez quand Dieu vous a appelés. C’est ce que j’enseigne dans toutes les églises.

es.L: Solamente, como el Señor ha repartido a cada uno, como Dios ha llamado a cada uno, así ande [cada uno]. Y así lo dispongo en todas las iglesias.
es.B: Sea como sea, cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debe llevar la vida que el Señor le ha dado, la vida que tenía cuando Dios lo llamó. Esto mismo es lo que dispongo en todas las iglesias.
es.R: Pero cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debe seguir viviendo la vida que el Señor le ha dado. Que cada uno siga en la situación en que estaba cuando Dios lo llamó. Esto es lo que enseño en todas las iglesias.

sw.L: Ila tu, kama Bwana alivyomgawia kila mmoja, kama Mungu alivyomwita kila mmoja, hivyo na aenende. Na hivyo ndivyo ninavyoagiza katika makanisa yote.
sw.B: Iwe vyovyote vile, kila mmoja wenu na aishi maisha ambayo Bwana amempa, maisha aliyokuwa nayo Mungu alipomwita. Ninatoa agizo hili hili katika makanisa yote.
sw.R: Lakini kila mmoja wenu aendelee kuishi maisha ambayo Bwana amempa. Kila mmoja abaki katika hali aliyokuwa nayo Mungu alipomwita. Hivi ndivyo ninavyofundisha katika makanisa yote.

vi.L: Chỉ có điều, như Chúa đã phân định cho mỗi người, như Đức Chúa Trời đã kêu gọi mỗi người, thì người ấy hãy bước đi như vậy. Và tôi truyền dạy như vậy trong tất cả các Hội Thánh.
vi.B: Dù thế nào đi nữa, mỗi người nên sống cuộc đời mà Chúa đã ban cho mình, như lúc Đức Chúa Trời kêu gọi mình. Tôi cũng truyền dạy như vậy trong mọi Hội Thánh.
vi.R: Nhưng mỗi người nên tiếp tục sống cuộc đời mà Chúa đã ban cho mình. Hãy ở trong hoàn cảnh của mình lúc Đức Chúa Trời gọi mình. Đó là điều tôi dạy trong tất cả các Hội Thánh.

ko.L: 다만 주님께서 각 사람에게 나누어 주신 대로, 하나님께서 각 사람을 부르신 대로, 그렇게 걸어가십시오. 나는 모든 교회에서 이렇게 지시합니다.
ko.B: 어떤 경우이든, 각 사람은 주님께서 주신 삶, 곧 하나님께서 부르셨을 때의 그 삶을 살아가십시오. 나는 모든 교회에 이와 같이 지시합니다.
ko.R: 여러분은 저마다 주님께서 주신 삶을 계속 살아가십시오. 하나님께서 부르셨을 때 있던 그 자리에 머무십시오. 나는 모든 교회에서 이렇게 가르칩니다.

pt.L: Somente, como o Senhor repartiu a cada um, como Deus chamou cada um, assim ande cada um. E assim ordeno em todas as igrejas.
pt.B: Seja como for, cada um de vocês deve levar a vida que o Senhor lhe deu, a vida que tinha quando Deus o chamou. Essa é a mesma orientação que dou em todas as igrejas.
pt.R: Mas cada um de vocês deve continuar vivendo a vida que o Senhor deu a cada um. Fiquem na situação em que estavam quando Deus chamou vocês. É isso que eu ensino em todas as igrejas.

am.L: ብቻ ጌታ ለእያንዳንዱ እንዳካፈለ፣ እግዚአብሔር እያንዳንዱን እንደ ጠራ፣ እንዲሁ ይመላለስ፤ እንዲሁም በአብያተ ክርስቲያናት ሁሉ አዝዛለሁ።
am.B: ያም ሆነ ይህ፣ እያንዳንዳችሁ ጌታ የሰጣችሁን ኑሮ፣ እግዚአብሔር ሲጠራችሁ የነበራችሁበትን ኑሮ ኑሩ። ይህንኑ በአብያተ ክርስቲያናት ሁሉ አዝዛለሁ።
am.R: ነገር ግን እያንዳንዳችሁ ጌታ የሰጣችሁን ኑሮ መኖራችሁን ቀጥሉ። እግዚአብሔር በጠራችሁ ጊዜ በነበራችሁበት ሁኔታ ቆዩ። በአብያተ ክርስቲያናት ሁሉ የማስተምረው ይህንኑ ነው።

hi.L: केवल, जैसा प्रभु ने हर एक को बाँटा है, जैसा परमेश्वर ने हर एक को बुलाया है, वैसे ही वह चले। और मैं सब कलीसियाओं में ऐसा ही ठहराता हूँ।
hi.B: बात चाहे जो हो, तुममें से हर एक वही जीवन जिए जो प्रभु ने उसे दिया है, वह जीवन जो उसका था जब परमेश्वर ने उसे बुलाया। मैं हर कलीसिया में यही निर्देश देता हूँ।
hi.R: पर तुममें से हर एक को वही जीवन जीते रहना चाहिए जो प्रभु ने उसे दिया है। जब परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें बुलाया, तब तुम जिस स्थिति में थे, उसी में रहो। मैं सब कलीसियाओं में यही सिखाता हूँ।

ru.L: Только как Господь уделил каждому, как Бог призвал каждого, так пусть [каждый] и ходит. И так я предписываю во всех церквах.
ru.B: Как бы то ни было, каждый из вас пусть живёт той жизнью, которую дал ему Господь, той, которая была у него, когда его призвал Бог. Это же указание я даю во всех церквах.
ru.R: Но каждый из вас пусть продолжает жить той жизнью, которую дал ему Господь. Оставайтесь в том положении, в котором вы были, когда Бог призвал вас. Этому я учу во всех церквах.

uk.L: Тільки як кожному Господь розділив, як кожного покликав Бог, так нехай кожен ходить. І так я наказую в усіх церквах.
uk.B: Хай там як, кожен із вас нехай живе тим життям, яке дав йому Господь, тим, яке він мав, коли його покликав Бог. Те саме я наказую в кожній церкві.
uk.R: Але кожен із вас нехай і далі живе тим життям, яке дав йому Господь. Залишайтеся в тому становищі, у якому ви були, коли Бог вас покликав. Цього я навчаю в усіх церквах.

ja.L: ただ、主が各自に分け与えられたとおりに、神が各自を召されたとおりに、そのように歩みなさい。わたしは、すべての教会でこのように指示しています。
ja.B: いずれにせよ、一人一人は、主が与えてくださった生活、神に召されたときの生活を送るべきです。わたしは、どの教会でも同じように指示しています。
ja.R: でも、一人一人は、主が与えてくださった生活を続けるべきです。神に召されたときの立場に、とどまっていてください。これは、わたしがすべての教会で教えていることです。

decisions.choice: only, in any case: Paul turns from the exception back to the rule
decisions.reason: Εἰ μὴ, normally "except", here means "only" or "in any case". Having allowed that a marriage may end (verse 15), Paul states the general rule that governs the rest of the chapter: stay in the situation you were in when called. He says it three times (verses 17, 20 and 24).

decisions.choice: assigned, called: the place in life the Lord gave, and God's call to faith that came there
decisions.reason: ἐμέρισεν means to give each a portion or share. κέκληκεν is God's call that brought them to faith (1:9, 26). The two lines say the same thing from two sides: the situation the Lord gave, and the call that came to them in it.

decisions.choice: walk: live, conduct one's life
decisions.reason: περιπατείτω is Paul's usual word for a way of life (3:3; Colossians 1:10).

decisions.choice: I direct this in all the churches: the rule is not special to Corinth
decisions.reason: διατάσσομαι means to give orders or arrange. Paul often reminds the Corinthians that what he asks of them he asks of every church (4:17; 11:16; 14:33).

decisions.choice: lead the life (B); keep living the life (R)
decisions.reason: "Walk" in this sense is not everyday English; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: the life you had when God called you (B); the situation you were in when God called you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "as God has called" refers to (m2).

decisions.choice: qu’il marche (L), mener sa vie (B, R); les églises, lowercase
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the image of walking for one's way of life, as the English does; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m3). The churches are many local congregations, so the lowercase of the style guide applies.

decisions.choice: ande
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of walking for the way one lives (m3), as Spanish "andar" is used in Romans 14:15; Balanced and Readable say "llevar la vida" and "seguir viviendo".

decisions.choice: aenende
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of walking ("kuenenda") for the way one lives; Balanced and Readable say "kuishi".

decisions.choice: "kêu gọi" (L, B), "gọi" (R) for kaleo; "sự kêu gọi" (L) for klesis in 7:20; "lúc Đức Chúa Trời kêu gọi" (B), "lúc Đức Chúa Trời gọi" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of 1:9 and 1:26 for God's call to faith; Balanced and Readable say when the call came, as the English does. "Ơn gọi" is a common church word, but to many readers it means a call to an office.

decisions.choice: "부르다", "부르심" (L, B, R) for God's call through verses 17-24; "그대로 지내다", "머무르다" for remaining
decisions.reason: "부르심" is God's call that brought them to faith, as in 1:26, and the situation in which it came; "소명" now suggests a career or vocation.

decisions.choice: "ይመላለስ" (let him walk) at Literal; "ኑሩ" (live) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: "መመላለስ" is the Amharic figure for conducting one's life (m3), so Literal can keep the picture; Balanced and Readable say "live".

decisions.choice: "वह चले"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of walking for a way of life (meaning decision m3), as in 3:3; Balanced and Readable say "जीवन जिए".

decisions.choice: ходит (L); живёт (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of walking for the way one lives (m3); Balanced and Readable say "live".

decisions.choice: покликати, покликання (L, B); Бог покликав (R), through the chapter
decisions.reason: The Corinthians note keeps "called, calling" for God's call to faith in chapter 7. Ukrainian "покликати" is the word of 1:1-2, so the link to Paul's own calling stays.

decisions.choice: "召された" for kaleō through 7:17-24 (L, B); "神に召された" (R)
decisions.reason: Book terms: called, calling; "召し" for klēsis (7:20).

en.L: Was anyone called having been circumcised?
en.B: Was someone already circumcised when he was called?
en.R: Was a man already circumcised when God called him?

fr.L: Quelqu’un a-t-il été appelé étant circoncis ?
fr.B: Quelqu’un était-il déjà circoncis quand il a été appelé ?
fr.R: Un homme était-il déjà circoncis quand Dieu l’a appelé ?

es.L: ¿Fue llamado alguno estando circuncidado?
es.B: ¿Ya estaba circuncidado alguien cuando fue llamado?
es.R: ¿Ya estaba circuncidado un hombre cuando Dios lo llamó?

sw.L: Je, mtu yeyote aliitwa akiwa ametahiriwa?
sw.B: Je, mtu alikuwa ameshatahiriwa alipoitwa?
sw.R: Je, mwanamume alikuwa ameshatahiriwa Mungu alipomwita?

vi.L: Có ai đã được kêu gọi khi đã chịu cắt bì không?
vi.B: Có ai đã chịu cắt bì rồi khi được kêu gọi không?
vi.R: Có người đàn ông nào đã chịu cắt bì khi Đức Chúa Trời gọi mình không?

ko.L: 누가 할례를 받은 상태에서 부르심을 받았습니까?
ko.B: 누가 이미 할례를 받은 몸으로 부르심을 받았습니까?
ko.R: 어떤 남자가 하나님께서 부르셨을 때 이미 할례를 받은 사람이었습니까?

pt.L: Alguém foi chamado sendo circuncidado?
pt.B: Alguém já era circuncidado quando foi chamado?
pt.R: Um homem já era circuncidado quando Deus o chamou?

am.L: ማንም ተገርዞ ተጠራ?
am.B: አንድ ሰው በተጠራ ጊዜ አስቀድሞ ተገርዞ ነበር?
am.R: አንድ ሰው እግዚአብሔር በጠራው ጊዜ አስቀድሞ ተገርዞ ነበር?

hi.L: क्या कोई ख़तना किया हुआ बुलाया गया?
hi.B: क्या कोई बुलाए जाने के समय पहले से ख़तना किया हुआ था?
hi.R: क्या किसी पुरुष का ख़तना पहले ही हो चुका था जब परमेश्वर ने उसे बुलाया?

ru.L: Призван ли кто обрезанным?
ru.B: Был ли кто-то уже обрезан, когда его призвали?
ru.R: Был ли мужчина уже обрезан, когда Бог призвал его?

uk.L: Чи покликаний хтось обрізаним?
uk.B: Чи хтось був уже обрізаний, коли його покликали?
uk.R: Чи чоловік уже був обрізаний, коли Бог покликав його?

ja.L: 割礼を受けている者が召されたのですか？
ja.B: だれかが、すでに割礼を受けている状態で召されたのですか？
ja.R: 神に召されたとき、すでに割礼を受けていた男の人がいますか？

decisions.choice: circumcised: a Jewish man, marked by circumcision
decisions.reason: Circumcision was the sign of God's covenant with Abraham and his descendants (Genesis 17:10-14). In a mixed church it marked out the Jewish men from the Gentiles.

decisions.choice: was called: was called by God to faith
decisions.reason: ἐκλήθη is passive with God as the one who calls (verse 17), as throughout this passage.

decisions.choice: when God called him
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who called.

decisions.choice: "chịu cắt bì" for circumcision (7:18-19)
decisions.reason: The word of the Vietnamese Galatians 2:3.

source.text: μὴ ἐπισπάσθω· ἐν ἀκροβυστίᾳ κέκληταί τις;

records.literal_gloss: Let him not draw over; in uncircumcision has been called anyone?

en.L: Let him not undo [his circumcision]. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision?
en.B: He must not try to reverse it. Was someone uncircumcised when he was called?
en.R: Then he should not try to undo it. Was a man not circumcised when God called him?

fr.L: Qu’il ne défasse pas [sa circoncision]. Quelqu’un a-t-il été appelé dans l’incirconcision ?
fr.B: Il ne doit pas chercher à en effacer la marque. Quelqu’un était-il incirconcis quand il a été appelé ?
fr.R: Alors il ne doit pas essayer de la faire disparaître. Un homme n’était-il pas circoncis quand Dieu l’a appelé ?

es.L: Que no se cubra [la circuncisión]. ¿Ha sido llamado alguno en incircuncisión?
es.B: Que no intente deshacerla. ¿No estaba circuncidado alguien cuando fue llamado?
es.R: Entonces no debe intentar deshacerla. ¿No estaba circuncidado un hombre cuando Dios lo llamó?

sw.L: Asiiondoe [tohara yake]. Je, mtu yeyote ameitwa katika hali ya kutotahiriwa?
sw.B: Asijaribu kuiondoa. Je, mtu alikuwa hajatahiriwa alipoitwa?
sw.R: Basi asijaribu kuiondoa. Je, mwanamume alikuwa hajatahiriwa Mungu alipomwita?

vi.L: Người ấy đừng xóa [dấu cắt bì]. Có ai đã được kêu gọi khi chưa cắt bì không?
vi.B: Người ấy đừng tìm cách xóa dấu cắt bì. Có ai chưa chịu cắt bì khi được kêu gọi không?
vi.R: Thì người ấy đừng tìm cách xóa dấu đó đi. Có người đàn ông nào chưa chịu cắt bì khi Đức Chúa Trời gọi mình không?

ko.L: 그는 [할례 흔적을] 없애지 마십시오. 누가 할례를 받지 않은 상태에서 부르심을 받았습니까?
ko.B: 그 사람은 할례의 흔적을 없애려 하지 마십시오. 누가 할례를 받지 않은 몸으로 부르심을 받았습니까?
ko.R: 그렇다면 그 사람은 할례받은 표시를 없애려고 하지 마십시오. 어떤 남자가 하나님께서 부르셨을 때 할례를 받지 않은 사람이었습니까?

pt.L: Não desfaça [a sua circuncisão]. Alguém foi chamado na incircuncisão?
pt.B: Não tente desfazê-la. Alguém não era circuncidado quando foi chamado?
pt.R: Então ele não deve tentar desfazer isso. Um homem não era circuncidado quando Deus o chamou?

am.L: [የመገረዙን ምልክት] አያጥፋ። ማንም ባለመገረዝ ተጠርቷል?
am.B: ያንን ለመቀልበስ አይሞክር። አንድ ሰው በተጠራ ጊዜ ያልተገረዘ ነበር?
am.R: እንግዲያው የመገረዙን ምልክት ለማጥፋት አይሞክር። አንድ ሰው እግዚአብሔር በጠራው ጊዜ ያልተገረዘ ነበር?

hi.L: वह [अपना ख़तना] न मिटाए। क्या कोई ख़तनारहित दशा में बुलाया गया है?
hi.B: वह उसे उलटने की कोशिश न करे। क्या कोई बुलाए जाने के समय ख़तनारहित था?
hi.R: तो वह उसे मिटाने की कोशिश न करे। क्या किसी पुरुष का ख़तना नहीं हुआ था जब परमेश्वर ने उसे बुलाया?

ru.L: Пусть не уничтожает [следов обрезания]. В необрезании ли призван кто?
ru.B: Пусть он не пытается это скрыть. Был ли кто-то необрезанным, когда его призвали?
ru.R: Тогда пусть он не пытается это изменить. Был ли мужчина необрезанным, когда Бог призвал его?

uk.L: Нехай не приховує [обрізання]. Чи покликаний хтось у необрізанні?
uk.B: Він не повинен намагатися це змінити. Чи хтось був необрізаний, коли його покликали?
uk.R: Тоді він не повинен намагатися це приховати. Чи чоловік не був обрізаний, коли Бог покликав його?

ja.L: [その跡を]元に戻してはいけません。割礼のない状態で召された者がいますか？
ja.B: その人は、それを元に戻そうとしてはいけません。割礼を受けていない状態で召された人がいますか？
ja.R: それなら、それを元に戻そうとしてはいけません。神に召されたとき、割礼を受けていなかった男の人がいますか？

decisions.choice: undo: have the marks of circumcision hidden by surgery
decisions.reason: ἐπισπάσθω means "draw over". Some Jewish men in the Greek world had an operation to hide their circumcision, to avoid mockery in the gymnasium or to fit in (1 Maccabees 1:15). Paul tells Jewish believers not to do so.

decisions.choice: in uncircumcision: as a Gentile
decisions.reason: ἀκροβυστίᾳ, uncircumcision, stands for the state of a Gentile man.

decisions.choice: try to reverse it (B); try to undo it (R)
decisions.reason: The literal "draw over" means nothing to a modern reader (m1).

decisions.choice: se cubra [la circuncisión] (L); deshacerla (B, R); en incircuncisión (L); no estaba circuncidado (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb means to draw over, hiding the mark of circumcision (m1); Literal keeps that picture and Balanced and Readable say "undo it". Literal keeps the noun "incircuncisión", as Galatians 5:6 does; the other levels say "not circumcised", which is plainer than "incircunciso".

decisions.choice: asiiondoe [tohara yake] (L); asijaribu kuiondoa (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Kuiondoa" (remove it, undo it) says what the operation set out to do, as the English "undo, reverse"; the meaning decision explains the practice.

decisions.choice: "የመገረዙን ምልክት" (the mark of his circumcision) as the object of "undo"
alternatives: "አይቀልብስ" (let him not reverse) with no object
decisions.reason: The Greek verb needs no object, but an Amharic verb for undoing does; the mark of circumcision is what was hidden (m1). Literal brackets it.

source.text: μὴ περιτεμνέσθω.

records.literal_gloss: Let him not be circumcised.

en.L: Let him not be circumcised.
en.B: He must not get circumcised.
en.R: Then he should not get circumcised.

fr.L: Qu’il ne se fasse pas circoncire.
fr.B: Il ne doit pas se faire circoncire.
fr.R: Alors il ne doit pas se faire circoncire.

es.L: Que no se circuncide.
es.B: Que no se haga circuncidar.
es.R: Entonces no debe circuncidarse.

sw.L: Asitahiriwe.
sw.B: Asikubali kutahiriwa.
sw.R: Basi asitahiriwe.

vi.L: Người ấy đừng chịu cắt bì.
vi.B: Người ấy đừng chịu cắt bì.
vi.R: Thì người ấy đừng chịu cắt bì.

ko.L: 그는 할례를 받지 마십시오.
ko.B: 그 사람은 할례를 받지 마십시오.
ko.R: 그렇다면 그 사람은 할례를 받지 마십시오.

pt.L: Não seja circuncidado.
pt.B: Ele não deve se circuncidar.
pt.R: Então ele não deve se circuncidar.

am.L: አይገረዝ።
am.B: መገረዝ የለበትም።
am.R: እንግዲያው መገረዝ የለበትም።

hi.L: वह ख़तना न कराए।
hi.B: वह ख़तना न कराए।
hi.R: तो वह ख़तना न कराए।

ru.L: Пусть не обрезается.
ru.B: Пусть он не делает обрезания.
ru.R: Тогда пусть он не делает обрезания.

uk.L: Нехай не обрізується.
uk.B: Він не повинен обрізуватися.
uk.R: Тоді він не повинен обрізуватися.

ja.L: 割礼を受けてはいけません。
ja.B: その人は割礼を受けてはいけません。
ja.R: それなら、割礼を受けようとしてはいけません。

decisions.choice: not be circumcised: a Gentile believer need not become a Jew
decisions.reason: Some taught that Gentile believers must be circumcised (Acts 15:1, 5; Galatians 5:2-6). Paul rejects this here as in his other letters.

source.text: ἡ περιτομὴ οὐδέν ἐστιν, καὶ ἡ ἀκροβυστία οὐδέν ἐστιν, ἀλλὰ τήρησις ἐντολῶν θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: The circumcision nothing is, and the uncircumcision nothing is, but keeping of commandments of God.

en.L: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but [what matters is the] keeping of [the] commandments of God.
en.B: Being circumcised means nothing, and not being circumcised means nothing. What matters is obeying the commandments of God.
en.R: It does not matter whether a man is circumcised or not. What matters is doing what God commands.

fr.L: La circoncision n’est rien, et l’incirconcision n’est rien, mais [ce qui compte, c’est] l’observation des commandements de Dieu.
fr.B: Être circoncis ne compte pour rien, et ne pas l’être ne compte pour rien. Ce qui compte, c’est d’obéir aux commandements de Dieu.
fr.R: Qu’un homme soit circoncis ou non, cela n’a pas d’importance. Ce qui compte, c’est de faire ce que Dieu commande.

es.L: La circuncisión nada es, y la incircuncisión nada es, sino [lo que importa es] el cumplimiento de [los] mandamientos de Dios.
es.B: Estar circuncidado no significa nada, y no estarlo tampoco significa nada. Lo que importa es obedecer los mandamientos de Dios.
es.R: No importa si un hombre está circuncidado o no. Lo que importa es hacer lo que Dios manda.

sw.L: Tohara si kitu, na kutotahiriwa si kitu, bali [kilicho muhimu ni] kuzishika amri za Mungu.
sw.B: Kutahiriwa si kitu, na kutotahiriwa si kitu. Kilicho muhimu ni kuzitii amri za Mungu.
sw.R: Haijalishi kama mwanamume ametahiriwa au la. Kilicho muhimu ni kufanya yale ambayo Mungu ameamuru.

vi.L: Cắt bì chẳng là gì, và không cắt bì cũng chẳng là gì, nhưng [điều quan trọng là] sự vâng giữ các điều răn của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Chịu cắt bì chẳng có nghĩa gì, và không chịu cắt bì cũng chẳng có nghĩa gì. Điều quan trọng là vâng giữ các điều răn của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Một người đàn ông có chịu cắt bì hay không thì cũng không quan trọng. Điều quan trọng là làm theo những gì Đức Chúa Trời truyền dạy.

ko.L: 할례도 아무것도 아니고 무할례도 아무것도 아니며, 하나님의 계명들을 지키는 것[만이 중요합니다].
ko.B: 할례를 받은 것도 아무것도 아니고, 할례를 받지 않은 것도 아무것도 아닙니다. 중요한 것은 하나님의 계명을 지키는 것입니다.
ko.R: 할례를 받았든 받지 않았든 중요하지 않습니다. 중요한 것은 하나님께서 명령하시는 것을 행하는 것입니다.

pt.L: A circuncisão nada é, e a incircuncisão nada é, mas [o que importa é a] observância dos mandamentos de Deus.
pt.B: Ser circuncidado não significa nada, e não ser circuncidado também não significa nada. O que importa é obedecer aos mandamentos de Deus.
pt.R: Não importa se um homem é circuncidado ou não. O que importa é fazer o que Deus manda.

am.L: መገረዝ ምንም አይደለም፤ አለመገረዝም ምንም አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን [የሚጠቅመው] የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዛት መጠበቅ [ነው]።
am.B: መገረዝ ምንም አይደለም፤ አለመገረዝም ምንም አይደለም። ዋናው ነገር የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዛት መጠበቅ ነው።
am.R: ሰው ቢገረዝም ባይገረዝም ለውጥ የለውም። ዋናው ነገር እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ማድረግ ነው።

hi.L: ख़तना कुछ नहीं, और ख़तनारहित होना कुछ नहीं, परंतु परमेश्वर की आज्ञाओं का पालन [ही सब कुछ है]।
hi.B: ख़तना होने का कोई अर्थ नहीं, और ख़तना न होने का भी कोई अर्थ नहीं। जो बात मायने रखती है, वह परमेश्वर की आज्ञाओं को मानना है।
hi.R: इससे कोई फ़र्क़ नहीं पड़ता कि किसी पुरुष का ख़तना हुआ है या नहीं। जो बात मायने रखती है, वह यह है कि हम वही करें जो परमेश्वर आज्ञा देते हैं।

ru.L: Обрезание — ничто, и необрезание — ничто, но [важно] соблюдение заповедей Божьих.
ru.B: Быть обрезанным ничего не значит, и не быть обрезанным ничего не значит. Важно исполнять заповеди Божьи.
ru.R: Неважно, обрезан мужчина или нет. Важно делать то, что повелевает Бог.

uk.L: Обрізання — ніщо, і необрізання — ніщо, а [важить] дотримання заповідей Божих.
uk.B: Бути обрізаним нічого не означає, і бути необрізаним нічого не означає. Важить виконувати Божі заповіді.
uk.R: Неважливо, обрізаний чоловік чи ні. Важливо робити те, що наказує Бог.

ja.L: 割礼は何ものでもなく、無割礼も何ものでもありません。[大事なのは]神の戒めを守ることです。
ja.B: 割礼を受けていることにも、受けていないことにも、何の意味もありません。大切なのは、神の戒めを守ることです。
ja.R: 割礼を受けているかどうかは、大切なことではありません。大切なのは、神が命じておられることを行うことです。

decisions.choice: keeping God's commandments: doing God's will, which is what counts, not one's birth or mark
decisions.reason: The saying is startling, because circumcision was itself one of God's commandments (Genesis 17:10). Paul means God's will as now made known in Christ. Galatians 5:6 and 6:15 make the same contrast with "faith working through love" and "a new creation".

decisions.choice: but ...: the verb is left out
decisions.reason: After ἀλλὰ the Greek simply names "keeping of the commandments of God"; the meaning is that this, unlike circumcision, is what counts.

decisions.choice: what matters
decisions.reason: English needs a verb here (m2). Literal puts it in brackets.

decisions.choice: tohara, kutotahiriwa (L); kutahiriwa, kutotahiriwa (B)
decisions.reason: As Colossians 2-3 and Galatians: "tohara" and "kutotahiriwa", the forms Swahili uses for the pair.

decisions.choice: "무할례" (L); "할례를 받지 않은 것" (B, R)
alternatives: "할례를 받지 않은 것" at every level
decisions.reason: The words of Romans 2:25 (L) and Galatians for uncircumcision.

source.text: ἕκαστος ἐν τῇ κλήσει ᾗ ἐκλήθη ἐν ταύτῃ μενέτω.

records.literal_gloss: Each in the calling in which he was called, in this let him remain.

en.L: Each one, in the calling in which {{gender:they were|he was}} called, in it let {{gender:them|him}} remain.
en.B: Each of you should go on in the place in life where God's call found you.
en.R: Each of you should stay as you were when God called you.

fr.L: Chacun, dans l’appel par lequel il a été appelé, qu’il y demeure.
fr.B: Que chacun de vous continue de vivre dans la situation où l’appel de Dieu l’a trouvé.
fr.R: Chacun de vous doit rester tel qu’il était quand Dieu l’a appelé.

es.L: Cada uno, en el llamamiento en que fue llamado, en él permanezca.
es.B: Cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debe seguir en el lugar de la vida en que lo encontró el llamamiento de Dios.
es.R: Cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debe quedarse como estaba cuando Dios lo llamó.

sw.L: Kila mmoja, katika wito ambao aliitwa, na akae katika huo.
sw.B: Kila mmoja wenu na aendelee katika nafasi ya maisha ambamo wito wa Mungu ulimkuta.
sw.R: Kila mmoja wenu abaki kama alivyokuwa Mungu alipomwita.

vi.L: Mỗi người được kêu gọi trong sự kêu gọi nào, hãy ở yên trong đó.
vi.B: Mỗi người nên tiếp tục sống trong hoàn cảnh mà mình đang ở khi Đức Chúa Trời kêu gọi mình.
vi.R: Mỗi người nên cứ ở như mình đã ở khi Đức Chúa Trời gọi mình.

ko.L: 각 사람은 부르심을 받은 그 부르심 안에 그대로 머무르십시오.
ko.B: 여러분은 저마다 하나님의 부르심을 받았을 때의 그 자리에서 그대로 살아가십시오.
ko.R: 여러분은 저마다 하나님께서 부르셨을 때의 모습 그대로 지내십시오.

pt.L: Cada um, no chamado em que foi chamado, nesse permaneça.
pt.B: Cada um de vocês deve continuar na situação de vida em que o chamado de Deus o encontrou.
pt.R: Cada um de vocês deve ficar como estava quando Deus o chamou.

am.L: እያንዳንዱ በተጠራበት ጥሪ፣ በዚያው ይኑር።
am.B: እያንዳንዳችሁ የእግዚአብሔር ጥሪ በደረሳችሁ ጊዜ በነበራችሁበት የኑሮ ሁኔታ ኑሩ።
am.R: እያንዳንዳችሁ እግዚአብሔር በጠራችሁ ጊዜ እንደ ነበራችሁ ሆናችሁ ቆዩ።

hi.L: हर एक जिस बुलाहट में बुलाया गया, उसी में बना रहे।
hi.B: तुममें से हर एक जीवन की उसी स्थिति में बना रहे जिसमें परमेश्वर की बुलाहट ने उसे पाया।

decisions.choice: calling: God's call, together with the situation in which it came
alternatives: the call itself: remain as one called
decisions.reason: κλήσει is God's act of calling (1:26). Here, with "remain in", it takes in the circumstances of the person when the call came: married or single, Jew or Gentile, slave or free. It does not yet have the later sense of a job or career.

decisions.choice: remain: go on in it, without striving to change it for God's sake
decisions.reason: μενέτω is the key word of verses 17-24. It is not an absolute ban on change: Paul has allowed for separation (verse 15) and may encourage a slave to take freedom (verse 21). The point is that no situation needs to be changed to please God.

decisions.choice: the place in life where God's call found you (B); as you were when God called you (R)
decisions.reason: In modern English "calling" usually means a career or a sense of vocation; Balanced and Readable say what it means here (m1). Literal keeps "calling".

decisions.choice: {{gender:they were|he was}}; {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: Each one means every believer, women and men.

decisions.choice: l’appel ... il a été appelé ... qu’il y demeure (L), with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Vocation" now suggests a career, as "calling" does in English, so Literal says "l’appel", which keeps the link with "appeler". The pronouns after "chacun" are ordinary generic French and take no setting, unlike the English "they/he".

decisions.choice: fue llamado, permanezca, no gender span
decisions.reason: The Spanish verbs do not show whether "each one" is a man or a woman, as in 3:14, so the English gender spans ({{gender:they were|he was}}) have nothing to change in Spanish.

decisions.choice: llamamiento
decisions.reason: "Llamamiento" is God's call and keeps the link with "llamar" (called) in the same verse; "vocación" would suggest a career.

decisions.choice: aliitwa, akae: no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in English
decisions.reason: The Swahili verb prefix a- means he or she, so the English gender spans have nothing to change.

decisions.choice: no gender span
alternatives: a gender span on a pronoun
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting for "they were/he was" and "them/him". Portuguese leaves the subject unspoken ("foi chamado", "permaneça"), and "cada um" already means every believer, so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: o chamado
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the noun of calling as "o chamado", which echoes the verb "chamar" as the Greek does. "Vocação" now means a career or talent, the sense the English decision warns against (m1).

decisions.choice: "ጥሪ" (calling) for klēsis
decisions.reason: "ጥሪ" is God's call, from the same root as "ተጠራ" (was called), which keeps Paul's repetition; "ሙያ" would make it a job (m1).

decisions.choice: "बुलाहट"
decisions.reason: Calling here is God's call together with the situation in which it came (meaning decision m1), not a career; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: положение в жизни, в котором его застал Божий призыв (B); таким, каким был, когда Бог призвал его (R)
decisions.reason: "Звание" (Synodal) now means a rank or title; the sense is God's call and the situation in which it came (m1).

decisions.choice: no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "they|he". The Ukrainian generic "кожен ... покликаний" covers men and women, and the reflexive needs no pronoun, so there is no second wording.

decisions.choice: slave: a person legally owned by another
decisions.reason: Slaves made up a large part of the population of Roman Corinth, and many belonged to the church (1:26-28). A slave was the owner's property; many were freed later in life. Paul speaks to them directly, as members of the church.

decisions.choice: slave
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level, as the style guide keeps it where slave is set against free (verses 21-23): the Greek word means one who was owned (m1), and the passage turns on that.

decisions.choice: esclave (every level, 7:21-23); tu
decisions.reason: As the English and the style guide: slave is set against free here, so "esclave" at every level. The Greek turns to a single reader, so French says "tu".

decisions.choice: esclavo at every level (verses 21-23)
decisions.reason: Slave is set against free in verses 21-23, so slavery itself is the point and every level keeps "esclavo", as the English does. Paul addresses one reader in the singular, "tú".

decisions.choice: mtumwa
decisions.reason: As the style guide and the English: slave set against free (verses 21-23), so "mtumwa" at every level, not "mtumishi".

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" at every level in 7:21-23, set against "người tự do"
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "slave" at every level where slavery itself is the point, as here, where slave and free are set side by side; "đầy tớ" would hide it. As in the Vietnamese Galatians 3:28.

decisions.choice: "노예" at every level through verses 21-23, set against "자유인"
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "slave" at every level where slavery itself is the point, as here, where slave is set against free and freed; Galatians 3:28 uses "노예" and "자유인" for the same pair. "당신" is the singular "you" in the polite style, as in 4:7.

decisions.choice: você
decisions.reason: The Greek verb here and in the next sentence is singular: Paul speaks to one slave among his readers, so Portuguese says "você" rather than the "vocês" used for the whole church.

decisions.choice: "ባሪያ" (slave) at every level, through verse 23
decisions.reason: Paul sets slave against free (verses 21 to 23), so the word must name a person owned by another (m1); "አገልጋይ" could be a hired worker.

decisions.choice: "दास"
decisions.reason: Doulos is "दास" at every level (style guide, section 7b), and here the point is a person legally owned by another (meaning decision m1), set against the free in verses 21-23.

decisions.choice: раб
decisions.reason: "Раб" at every level, as the style guide keeps it for doulos, and here a slave is set against the free (verses 21-23).

decisions.choice: раб at every level
decisions.reason: The Corinthians note says "slave" at every level where slavery itself is the point; Ukrainian keeps "раб" throughout, as in Romans.

decisions.choice: "奴隷" at every level in 7:21-23
decisions.reason: Slave and free is the point here (style table, book terms).

uk.R: Не переймайся цим. Але якщо матимеш нагоду стати вільним, скористайся нею.

ja.L: それを気にかけてはいけません。しかし、もし自由の身になることができるなら、むしろそれを用いなさい。
ja.B: そのことで心を悩ませてはいけません。しかし、もし自由になる機会があるなら、それを生かしなさい。

decisions.choice: rather make use of it: take the opportunity to become free
alternatives: rather make use of your present state: stay a slave even if you could be freed
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "rather use", with no object. Read with ἀλλ ("but") and εἰ καὶ as "if indeed", it makes an exception to the rule of remaining: take freedom if it is offered. The aorist χρῆσαι suits seizing a particular chance. Read with εἰ καὶ as "even if", it means "even if you can be freed, rather make use of your slavery", which fits the repeated "remain" of verses 20 and 24. Both readings have long been held, and the evidence is evenly balanced.

decisions.choice: do not let it concern you: being a slave does not lower a person's standing with God
decisions.reason: μελέτω means to be a worry or concern. Verse 22 gives the reason: in the Lord a slave is the Lord's freed person.

decisions.choice: become free: be set free by one's owner
decisions.reason: In the Roman world many slaves were freed, by their owner's choice or by buying their freedom with their savings. A slave could not usually decide it alone, so Paul speaks of being "able" to become free.

decisions.choice: make the most of it (B); take it (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the reading in m1 and say what is to be used: the chance of freedom. Literal keeps the Greek without an object.

decisions.choice: "[그 기회를] 이용하십시오" (L); "그 기회를 잘 살리십시오" (B); "그 기회를 잡으십시오" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "rather use"; the meaning decision reads it as taking the opportunity to become free, with the other reading footnoted.

decisions.choice: "むしろそれを用いなさい" (L); "それを生かしなさい" (B); "それを受け入れてください" (R)
alternatives: "むしろ今のままでいなさい"
decisions.reason: Follows m1 (uncertain, footnoted): take the chance of freedom.

source.text: ὁ γὰρ ἐν κυρίῳ κληθεὶς δοῦλος ἀπελεύθερος κυρίου ἐστίν· ὁμοίως ὁ ἐλεύθερος κληθεὶς δοῦλός ἐστιν Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: The for in [the] Lord having been called slave a freedman of [the] Lord is; likewise the free having been called a slave is of Christ.

en.L: For the slave who was called in [the] Lord is [the] Lord's freedman; likewise the free [one] who was called is a slave of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: For a slave who has been called in the Lord is the Lord's freed slave; and in the same way, someone free who has been called is a slave of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: A slave whom God has called to belong to the Lord has been set free by the Lord. And a free person whom God has called has become a slave of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

fr.L: Car l’esclave qui a été appelé dans le Seigneur est un affranchi du Seigneur ; de même, celui qui a été appelé [étant] libre est un esclave du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Car l’esclave qui a été appelé dans le Seigneur est un affranchi du Seigneur ; de même, celui qui était libre quand il a été appelé est un esclave du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.R: Un esclave que Dieu a appelé à appartenir au Seigneur a été libéré par le Seigneur. Et une personne libre que Dieu a appelée est devenue esclave du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

es.L: Porque el esclavo que fue llamado en [el] Señor es liberto del Señor; asimismo el libre que fue llamado es esclavo de {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}.
es.B: Porque el esclavo que ha sido llamado en el Señor es un esclavo liberado del Señor; y, de la misma manera, el que era libre cuando fue llamado es esclavo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.
es.R: Un esclavo a quien Dios ha llamado a pertenecer al Señor ha sido liberado por el Señor. Y quien era libre cuando Dios lo llamó se ha convertido en esclavo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana mtumwa aliyeitwa katika Bwana ni mtu aliyeachwa huru na Bwana; vivyo hivyo yeye aliyeitwa akiwa huru ni mtumwa wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana mtumwa aliyeitwa katika Bwana ni mtu ambaye Bwana amemweka huru; na vivyo hivyo, mtu huru aliyeitwa ni mtumwa wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Mtumwa ambaye Mungu amemwita awe wa Bwana, Bwana amemweka huru. Na mtu huru ambaye Mungu amemwita amekuwa mtumwa wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

vi.L: Vì người nô lệ được kêu gọi trong Chúa là người được Chúa giải phóng; cũng vậy, người tự do được kêu gọi là nô lệ của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Vì người nô lệ được kêu gọi trong Chúa là người nô lệ đã được Chúa trả tự do; cũng vậy, người tự do được kêu gọi là nô lệ của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Người nô lệ mà Đức Chúa Trời đã gọi để thuộc về Chúa là người đã được Chúa trả tự do. Và người tự do mà Đức Chúa Trời đã gọi thì đã trở thành nô lệ của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.

ko.L: 주님 안에서 부르심을 받은 노예는 주님의 해방된 사람이고, 마찬가지로 부르심을 받은 자유인은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 노예입니다.
ko.B: 주님 안에서 부르심을 받은 노예는 주님께서 자유롭게 하신 사람입니다. 마찬가지로 부르심을 받은 자유인은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 노예입니다.
