pt.L: Pois o escravo que foi chamado no Senhor é liberto do Senhor; igualmente, o livre que foi chamado é escravo {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}.
pt.B: Pois o escravo que foi chamado no Senhor é um escravo liberto do Senhor; e, da mesma forma, quem era livre quando foi chamado é escravo {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}.
pt.R: O escravo que Deus chamou para pertencer ao Senhor foi libertado pelo Senhor. E a pessoa livre que Deus chamou se tornou escrava {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}.

am.L: በጌታ የተጠራ ባሪያ የጌታ ነፃ የወጣ ሰው ነውና፤ እንዲሁም ነፃ [ሆኖ] የተጠራው {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ባሪያ ነው።
am.B: በጌታ የተጠራ ባሪያ ጌታ ነፃ ያወጣው ሰው ነውና፤ እንዲሁም ነፃ ሆኖ የተጠራ ሰው {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ባሪያ ነው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር የጌታ እንዲሆን የጠራው ባሪያ ጌታ ነፃ አውጥቶታል። እግዚአብሔር የጠራው ነፃ ሰውም {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ባሪያ ሆኗል።

hi.L: क्योंकि जो दास प्रभु में बुलाया गया, वह प्रभु का स्वतंत्र किया हुआ है; वैसे ही जो स्वतंत्र बुलाया गया, वह मसीह का दास है।
hi.B: क्योंकि जो दास प्रभु में बुलाया गया है, वह प्रभु का आज़ाद किया हुआ दास है; और इसी तरह जो स्वतंत्र व्यक्ति बुलाया गया है, वह मसीह का दास है।
hi.R: जिस दास को परमेश्वर ने प्रभु का होने के लिए बुलाया है, उसे प्रभु ने आज़ाद कर दिया है। और जिस स्वतंत्र व्यक्ति को परमेश्वर ने बुलाया है, वह मसीह का दास बन गया है।

ru.L: Ведь призванный в Господе раб — вольноотпущенник Господа; так же и призванный свободный — раб {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}.
ru.B: Ведь раб, призванный в Господе, — освобождённый раб Господа, и так же свободный человек, когда он призван, — раб {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}.
ru.R: Раба, которого Бог призвал принадлежать Господу, Господь сделал свободным. А свободный человек, которого призвал Бог, стал рабом {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}.

uk.L: Бо покликаний у Господі раб — вільновідпущеник Господа; так само й покликаний вільний — раб {{christos:Христа|Месії}}.
uk.B: Бо раб, покликаний у Господі, — Господній вільновідпущеник; так само й вільний, коли його покликано, — раб {{christos:Христа|Месії}}.
uk.R: Раб, якого Бог покликав належати Господу, звільнений Господом. А вільна людина, яку Бог покликав, стала рабом {{christos:Христа|Месії}}.

ja.L: というのは、主にあって召された奴隷は主の解放奴隷であり、同じように、召された自由人は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の奴隷だからです。
ja.B: 主にあって召された奴隷は、主によって解放された奴隷です。同じように、召された自由な人は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の奴隷なのです。
ja.R: 神に召されて主のものとなった奴隷は、主によって自由にされています。そして、神に召された自由な人は、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の奴隷になったのです。

decisions.choice: freedman: a former slave set free by his owner, who still owed that owner loyalty
decisions.reason: A freed slave in Roman society took the former owner as patron and owed him honor and certain services. So the believing slave is truly free in the Lord, and at the same time belongs to him.

decisions.choice: called in the Lord: called by God into union with the Lord
alternatives: "in the Lord" describing the slave rather than the calling
decisions.reason: ἐν κυρίῳ goes most naturally with κληθεὶς: the call that brought the person to belong to the Lord.

decisions.choice: the free person is Christ's slave: both slave and free now stand on the same footing before Christ
decisions.reason: Paul turns both statuses around: the slave is free in the Lord, and the free person belongs to Christ as a slave belongs to a master. Paul calls himself a slave of Christ (Romans 1:1; Philippians 1:1). Verse 23 gives the ground: they were bought.

decisions.choice: freedman (L); freed slave (B); has been set free (R)
decisions.reason: "Freedman" is little used today; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: slave
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level, as the style guide keeps it where slave is set against free and freed: the verse turns the two statuses around (m1, m3).

decisions.choice: un affranchi (L, B)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced says "freed slave" because "freedman" is rare. French "affranchi" is still a known word for a freed slave, and it keeps the legal status of m1, so Balanced keeps it; Readable says "libéré".

decisions.choice: liberto (L); esclavo liberado (B); ha sido liberado (R)
decisions.reason: "Liberto" is the Spanish word for a former slave set free by the owner (m1), and Literal keeps it; Balanced and Readable say it in everyday words.

decisions.choice: mtu aliyeachwa huru na Bwana (L); mtu ambaye Bwana amemweka huru (B)
decisions.reason: Swahili has no everyday noun for a freed slave, so the freedman is described with a relative clause; "mtumwa" stays for slave at every level, as in verse 21.

decisions.choice: "người được Chúa giải phóng" (L); "người nô lệ đã được Chúa trả tự do" (B); "người đã được Chúa trả tự do" (R) for apeleutheros
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has no single word for a freedman; each level says he is a slave set free by his owner, the Lord (m1).

decisions.choice: "해방된 사람" (L); "주님께서 자유롭게 하신 사람" (B, R) for the freedman
decisions.reason: The meaning decision describes a former slave set free by his owner, who still owed that owner loyalty; Korean says that he was set free by the Lord.

decisions.choice: liberto (L); escravo liberto (B)
decisions.reason: Portuguese has the exact word for a freed slave, "liberto", so Literal needs no paraphrase; Balanced adds "escravo" to make it plain. "Alforriado" belongs to Brazil's own history of slavery and would carry that setting into the text.

decisions.choice: "मसीह" with no christos setting
decisions.reason: "मसीह" is both the familiar name and the word Messiah itself, so the choice the English setting offers is already made (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: "स्वतंत्र किया हुआ" (L); "आज़ाद किया हुआ दास" (B)
decisions.reason: A freedman was a former slave set free by his owner (meaning decision m1); Hindi has no single word, so each level describes him.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}
decisions.reason: The title setting, inflected inside each option.

decisions.choice: вольноотпущенник (L); освобождённый раб (B)
decisions.reason: A former slave set free by his owner, who still owed that owner loyalty (m1); Balanced uses plainer words.

decisions.choice: вільновідпущеник
decisions.reason: The legal term for a slave set free by his owner, who still owed him loyalty (m1); Readable says "звільнений".

decisions.choice: "解放奴隷" (L); "解放された奴隷" (B); "自由にされています" (R)
decisions.reason: A former slave freed by his owner (m1).

source.text: τιμῆς ἠγοράσθητε· μὴ γίνεσθε δοῦλοι ἀνθρώπων.

records.literal_gloss: Of a price you were bought; do not become slaves of men.

en.L: You were bought for a price; do not become slaves of {{gender:human beings|men}}.
en.B: You were bought, and a price was paid for you. Do not become slaves of {{gender:human beings|men}}.
en.R: God paid the price to make you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own. So do not become slaves of {{gender:people|men}}.

fr.L: Vous avez été achetés à un prix ; ne devenez pas esclaves des {{gender:humains|hommes}}.
fr.B: Vous avez été achetés, et un prix a été payé pour vous. Ne devenez pas esclaves des {{gender:humains|hommes}}.
fr.R: Dieu a payé le prix pour que vous soyez à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Alors ne devenez pas esclaves des {{gender:gens|hommes}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Fueron|Fuisteis}} comprados por un precio; no {{plural_you:se hagan|os hagáis}} esclavos de {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Fueron|Fuisteis}} comprados, y se pagó un precio por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. No {{plural_you:se hagan|os hagáis}} esclavos de {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}.
es.R: Dios pagó el precio para {{plural_you:hacerlos|haceros}} {{deity_pronoun:suyos|Suyos}}. Así que no {{plural_you:se hagan|os hagáis}} esclavos de {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}.

sw.L: Mlinunuliwa kwa gharama; msiwe watumwa wa wanadamu.
sw.B: Mlinunuliwa, na gharama ililipwa kwa ajili yenu. Msiwe watumwa wa wanadamu.
sw.R: Mungu alilipa gharama ili mwe mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Kwa hiyo msiwe watumwa wa watu.

vi.L: Anh chị em đã được mua bằng một giá; đừng trở nên nô lệ của loài người.
vi.B: Anh chị em đã được mua, và một giá đã được trả cho anh chị em. Đừng trở thành nô lệ của loài người.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã trả giá để anh chị em thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vậy đừng trở thành nô lệ của loài người.

ko.L: 여러분은 값으로 산 사람들입니다. 사람의 노예가 되지 마십시오.
ko.B: 하나님께서 값을 치르고 여러분을 사셨습니다. 사람의 노예가 되지 마십시오.
ko.R: 하나님께서 값을 치르셔서 여러분을 그분의 것으로 삼으셨습니다. 그러니 사람의 노예가 되지 마십시오.

pt.L: Vocês foram comprados por um preço; não se tornem escravos {{gender:de seres humanos|de homens}}.
pt.B: Vocês foram comprados, e um preço foi pago por vocês. Não se tornem escravos {{gender:de seres humanos|de homens}}.
pt.R: Deus pagou o preço para que vocês sejam {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Então não se tornem escravos {{gender:das pessoas|dos homens}}.

am.L: በዋጋ ተገዝታችኋል፤ የሰዎች ባሪያዎች አትሁኑ።
am.B: ተገዝታችኋል፤ ዋጋም ተከፍሎላችኋል። የሰዎች ባሪያዎች አትሁኑ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር የራሱ ሊያደርጋችሁ ዋጋ ከፍሏል። ስለዚህ የሰዎች ባሪያዎች አትሁኑ።

hi.L: तुम दाम देकर मोल लिए गए हो; मनुष्यों के दास न बनो।
hi.B: तुम मोल लिए गए हो, और तुम्हारे लिए दाम चुकाया गया है। मनुष्यों के दास न बनो।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें अपना बनाने के लिए दाम चुकाया है। इसलिए मनुष्यों के दास न बनो।

ru.L: Вы куплены за цену; не становитесь рабами людей.
ru.B: Вас купили, за вас заплачена цена. Не становитесь рабами людей.
ru.R: Бог заплатил цену, чтобы сделать вас своими. Поэтому не становитесь рабами людей.

uk.L: Ви куплені за ціну; не ставайте рабами людей.
uk.B: Вас купили, і за вас заплачено ціну. Не ставайте рабами людей.
uk.R: Бог заплатив ціну, щоб ви належали {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}. Тож не ставайте рабами людей.

ja.L: あなたがたは代価を払って買い取られたのです。人間の奴隷となってはいけません。
ja.B: あなたがたは買い取られたのです。あなたがたのために代価が支払われました。人間の奴隷になってはいけません。
ja.R: 神は代金を払って、みなさんをご自分のものにしてくださいました。ですから、人間の奴隷にならないでください。

decisions.choice: bought for a price: purchased, as in the slave market, by Christ's death, so that they now belong to God
decisions.reason: ἠγοράσθητε is the ordinary word for buying, and in this passage the picture is of a slave changing owners. Paul used the same two words in 6:20. The price is not named here; elsewhere it is Christ's death (Galatians 3:13).

decisions.choice: do not become slaves of human beings: do not let people be your masters in place of the Lord
alternatives: do not sell yourselves into slavery
decisions.reason: Some free people sold themselves into slavery to pay debts or to gain security, and Paul may have this in view. But the plural command is addressed to the whole church, slave and free, and most naturally means: do not let human opinions or demands rule you, since you belong to God.

decisions.choice: God paid the price to make you his own
alternatives: You were bought for a price
decisions.reason: Readable names the buyer and the purpose (m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:human beings|men}} (L, B); {{gender:people|men}} (R)
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general.

decisions.choice: slaves
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level, as the style guide keeps it for people bought and owned, set against freedom: the verse turns on being bought (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: {{gender:humains|hommes}} (L, B); {{gender:gens|hommes}} (R); bought "à un prix" as in 6:20
decisions.reason: As in English, the word means human beings in general. The purchase is worded as in 6:20 at each level, since the Greek repeats it.

decisions.choice: comprados por un precio (L); comprados, y se pagó un precio (B); Dios pagó el precio (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as in 6:20 for the same Greek phrase, as the English keeps them.

decisions.choice: {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} (L, B); {{gender:la gente|los hombres}} (R)
decisions.reason: Spanish follows the English setting: the word means human beings of either sex, so the inclusive form is the default and "los hombres" the traditional one.

decisions.choice: mlinunuliwa kwa gharama (L); mlinunuliwa, na gharama ililipwa (B); Mungu alilipa gharama (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as 6:20, as the decision there says.

decisions.choice: wanadamu (L, B); watu (R): no gender span
decisions.reason: Already inclusive; "wanaume" would mean males and change the meaning.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span ("अपना"); "मनुष्यों" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters for the English deity_pronoun setting to change, and "मनुष्य" already includes women and men (style guide, section 7). The wording of "bought for a price" is that of 6:20.

decisions.choice: чтобы сделать вас своими
decisions.reason: God is the subject, so Russian uses the reflexive "свой", which takes no setting; the English has one for "his".

decisions.choice: рабами людей, with no gender span
decisions.reason: Ukrainian "люди" already includes men and women, so the English span has nothing to change.

source.text: ἕκαστος ἐν ᾧ ἐκλήθη, ἀδελφοί, ἐν τούτῳ μενέτω παρὰ θεῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Each in what he was called, brothers, in this let him remain with God.

en.L: Each one, in what {{gender:they were|he was}} called, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, in this let {{gender:them|him}} remain with God.
en.B: So, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, whatever your situation was when God called you, remain in it, living in God's presence.
en.R: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, whatever you were when God called you, stay that way, and live close to God.

fr.L: Chacun, dans ce en quoi il a été appelé, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, qu’il y demeure auprès de Dieu.
fr.B: Ainsi, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, quelle que soit la situation où vous étiez quand Dieu vous a appelés, restez-y, en vivant devant Dieu.
fr.R: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, restez tels que vous étiez quand Dieu vous a appelés, et vivez près de Dieu.

es.L: Cada uno, en lo que fue llamado, hermanos, en eso permanezca delante de Dios.
es.B: Así que, hermanos, cualquiera que fuera {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} situación cuando Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó, {{plural_you:permanezcan|permaneced}} en ella, viviendo en la presencia de Dios.
es.R: Hermanos, sea lo que sea que {{plural_you:eran|erais}} cuando Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó, {{plural_you:sigan|seguid}} así, y {{plural_you:vivan|vivid}} cerca de Dios.

sw.L: Kila mmoja, katika [hali] aliyoitwa, ndugu, na akae katika hiyo mbele za Mungu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, ndugu, hali yoyote mliyokuwa nayo Mungu alipowaita, kaeni ndani yake, mkiishi mbele za Mungu.
sw.R: Ndugu zangu, vyovyote mlivyokuwa Mungu alipowaita, bakini hivyo, na mkae karibu na Mungu.

vi.L: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, mỗi người được kêu gọi trong [hoàn cảnh] nào, hãy ở yên trong đó trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, khi Đức Chúa Trời kêu gọi anh chị em, anh chị em ở trong hoàn cảnh nào, thì hãy cứ ở trong hoàn cảnh ấy, sống trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, khi Đức Chúa Trời gọi anh chị em, anh chị em là người thế nào, thì hãy cứ ở như vậy, và sống gần gũi với Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 각 사람은 부르심을 받은 그 상태에서 하나님과 함께 머무르십시오.
ko.B: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 하나님께서 여러분을 부르셨을 때 여러분이 어떤 처지에 있었든지, 하나님 앞에서 살아가며 그 자리에 머무르십시오.
ko.R: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 하나님께서 여러분을 부르셨을 때의 모습 그대로 지내십시오. 그리고 하나님 가까이에서 사십시오.

pt.L: Cada um, naquilo em que foi chamado, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, nisso permaneça diante de Deus.
pt.B: Assim, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, qualquer que fosse a situação de vocês quando Deus os chamou, permaneçam nela, vivendo na presença de Deus.
pt.R: {{gender:Irmãos e irmãs|Irmãos}}, continuem do jeito que estavam quando Deus chamou vocês, e vivam perto de Deus.

am.L: እያንዳንዱ በተጠራበት [ሁኔታ]፣ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ በዚያው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይኑር።
am.B: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ እግዚአብሔር በጠራችሁ ጊዜ በነበራችሁበት ሁኔታ ሁሉ በእርሱ ፊት እየኖራችሁ በዚያው ጸንታችሁ ቆዩ።
am.R: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ እግዚአብሔር በጠራችሁ ጊዜ እንደ ነበራችሁ ሆናችሁ ቆዩ፤ ከእግዚአብሔርም ጋር ተቀራርባችሁ ኑሩ።

hi.L: हर एक, {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, जिस [दशा] में बुलाया गया, उसी में परमेश्वर के साथ बना रहे।
hi.B: इसलिए, {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, जब परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें बुलाया तब तुम्हारी जो भी स्थिति थी, उसी में परमेश्वर की उपस्थिति में जीते हुए बने रहो।
hi.R: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, जब परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें बुलाया तब तुम जो भी थे, वैसे ही रहो, और परमेश्वर के निकट जियो।

ru.L: Каждый, в чём призван, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, в том пусть и остаётся перед Богом.
ru.B: Итак, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, в каком бы положении вас ни застал Божий призыв, оставайтесь в нём, живя перед Богом.
ru.R: {{gender:Братья и сёстры|Братья}}, кем бы вы ни были, когда Бог призвал вас, оставайтесь такими и живите рядом с Богом.

uk.L: Кожен, у чому покликаний, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, у тому нехай і залишається перед Богом.
uk.B: Тож, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, у якому б становищі ви не були, коли Бог покликав вас, залишайтеся в ньому, живучи перед Божим лицем.
uk.R: {{gender:Брати і сестри|Брати}}, ким би ви не були, коли Бог покликав вас, залишайтеся такими і живіть близько до Бога.

ja.L: {{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、各自は召されたときの[状態]のうちに、神の前でとどまりなさい。
ja.B: ですから、{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、神に召されたときの立場がどのようなものであっても、そのままで、神の前で生きていきなさい。
ja.R: {{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、神に召されたときにどんな立場だったとしても、そのままでいてください。そして、神のそば近くで生きてください。

decisions.choice: with God: before God, living in his presence
decisions.reason: παρὰ θεῷ means "beside God" or "in God's presence". The situation stays the same, but it is now lived with God, which is what changes it.

decisions.choice: each in what he was called, in this let him remain: the rule of verses 17 and 20, given a third time to close the section
decisions.reason: The repetition rounds off the section on circumcision and slavery before Paul goes on to the unmarried in verse 25.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: As in 1:10, Paul writes to the whole church, women and men.

decisions.choice: living in God's presence (B); live close to God (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "with God" means here (m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} for the readers
decisions.reason: As in English, Paul writes to the whole church, women and men; "frères" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in 1:10, Spanish "hermanos" already includes the sisters, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in English
decisions.reason: As 1:10: "ndugu" already includes sisters, so the English gender span has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}
decisions.reason: Paul writes to the whole church, women and men, as the English decision says; Hindi uses the style guide's span for adelphoi in the vocative.

decisions.choice: {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}
decisions.reason: The gender setting, as in 1:10: Paul writes to the whole church.
